name: 3TMOBILESTORY
description: Premium branded handphone accessories at affordable prices! Fashion forward design casings and 1000+ phone models for screen protectors. Something for everyone!

name: 4Fingers Crispy Chicken
description: Fresh ingredients, hand-brushed to crispy perfection with our naturally fermented soy sauces that pack a kick-ass punch. Bringing you an out of this world crispy chicken experience.

name: 7-Eleven
description: Established in Singapore in 1983, 7-Eleven has since expanded to more than 400 stores island-wide to become the leading 24-hour convenience chain store. We take pride in serving the Singapore community 24 hours a day, 365 days a year. 7-Eleven emphasises convenience and value by offering a wide array of quality products, food and services to satisfy the needs of its customers. Think 7-Eleven, and what comes to mind is the refreshing Slurpee, 7Café, as well as a wide range of quality Ready Meals and sandwiches under 7-Select. 7-Eleven is also a 24/7 one-stop destination for customers who need to access bill payment services in their own time. Our services cover payment of utilities, courier services, and even cash withdrawal.

name: A-ROY THAI
description: We are family business that has been serving delicious Thai food in Singapore for the past 3 decades. With roots in the Isan province of Thailand, where the cuisine is renowned for its strong, spicy flavours and fragrant herbs. We take pride in our heritage and the authenticity of our dishes. Lovingly made from scratch by hand and using only the freshest.

name: Aburi-En
description: Aburi-EN is a cosy Japanese restaurant which offers unique, mouth-watering dishes. Aburi, which literally means “flame seared”, brings out the perfection in each dish, balancing each component’s texture and coordinating their flavors so that both come together to create the awesome taste, tantalizing your taste buds. Oishi!!

name: ActionCity
description: Founded in 2000, ActionCity has been a pioneer in the pop culture art toy scene, securing exclusive distributorship rights for Hot Toys and BE@RBRICK by Medicom Toy, while collaborating with brands like Disney and tokidoki.

name: adidas Originals
description: Strengthening the bond between the brand and the consumer, the space encapsulates the raw energy and ideology of the streets which enforces their status as the street-culture brand of today. The new adidas Neighbourhood will stock the latest drops and celebrate the local creative scene –leading the front in shaping the new-new in Singapore.

name: adidas
description: A ”stadium-inspired” space inspired by athletes will help shoppers get in the zone. Bringing the best sports apparel, shoes and equipment in Singapore, this home of sport by adidas will feature the latest innovations and well-loved staples by the brand. Look out for the local signatures in store done in collaboration with Creators, reinterpreting/reimagining the story of sport in Singapore. Follow @adidasSG on Instagram and Facebook for news on the latest drops and community features.

name: Adonis
description: Adonis is a leading and trusted beauty brand that specializes in facial treatments. Their therapies focus on drawing out the best of Nature’s essence, allowing their customers to exhibit a radiance that others notice and admire!

name: Adore Cosmetics
description: Adore Cosmetics has instituted an ingredient for better skincare known as the Queen of the Meadow: the meadowsweet extract. This herb, also known as Spiraea Ulmaria, is a traditional remedy due to its medicinal properties containing salicylic acid derivatives. Using soil-free cultivation in greenhouses and Plant Milking technology, our meadowsweet extract is derived from the roots of the living plant, accessing the richest part of the plants that are full of active ingredients. As a COSMOS-standard certified ingredient, our meadowsweet extract keeps the skin hydrated and helps skin cells to rejuvenate with a smoother look on the surface while simultaneously building a stronger barrier against wrinkles and other signs of premature aging.

name: Aesop
description: Aesop was established in Melbourne in 1987. Its objective has always been to formulate products of the finest quality, and to weave ourselves into the fabric of the neighbourhoods in which it establishes a presence.

name: Ah Mah Homemade Cake
description: Traditional Homemade Egg Sponge Cake – Made purely with milk, eggs, quality flour & some TLC. It is soft, fluffy and melts in your mouth. This is Ah Mah’s taste of happiness!

name: AIBI
description: With the slogan “Beauty in Wellness”, AIBI provides a holistic approach towards beauty and wellness. AIBI offers simple, fast and effective solutions to look good, stylish, beautiful and feel great.

name: Alijiang Silk Road Cuisine and Western Mahua
description: Alijiang Silk Road Cuisine Alijiang 阿里疆 is nurtured from countless of civilizations. The restaurant inherited valuable cooking knowledge from the Silk Road civilization, such as combining Western European catering philosophy, Central Asian Arab cooking concept and ancient Eastern catering culture, which essentially highlights the “Silk Road Cuisine”. Featuring their roast meat in Central Asia to Roast Duck in Beijing, the inheritance of ancient cooking and the fusion of various ingredients is the key to creating these delicious dishes. Western Mahua Hailing from Xinjiang, Western Mahua is a Muslim-friendly restaurant serving delicious Chinese dishes that is pork and lard-free. Steeped in the traditions and culinary culture of the Western regions of China, Western Mahua’s signature dish is a bowl of beef noodles, cooked and perfected over 30 years in strict adherence to the original recipes handed down over generations. Often hailed as the “Best Noodles in China”, beef noodles have more than a century of history in China’s western regions, earning domestic and international fame for its clear but flavourful soup base, tender fragrant beef and hand-pulled noodles. Pay with eWallet

name: ALUXE
description: As the leading jewellery brand in Taiwan, ALUXE embodies the perfect combination of happiness and jewellery. Whether you are experiencing a wonderful relationship, expressing your feelings to your loved one, or wanting to pamper yourself, ALUXE looks forward to offering you the perfect experience. Every ALUXE piece is crafted for love, tailored to you.

name: Amaris
description: Housing the most exclusive and distinctive fragrance brands, AMARIS is a scent utopia that promises a 360° olfactory experience for shoppers, be it an experienced nose or someone who is just exploring the realm of niche fragrances.

name: andar
description: Korea’s No.1 technical athleisure brand, andar offers performance-driven apparel designed for movement in everyday life. Our pieces are built for comfort, function, and style — from yoga and pilates to business casual and daily wear.

name: ANTA
description: ANTA Sports is a leading brand of sportswear, which has been engaged in the design, development, production and marketing of the ANTA series of sports equipment for many years. It provides customers with professional sports products, including footwear, apparel and accessories.

name: Apgujeong Hair Studio
description: Apgujeong Hair Studio seeks to bring the most current Korean inspired trends and designs to their local clientele. With a team of highly skilled local stylists trained by their Korean Chief Director Stylist, Kyle, their team seeks to infuse cutting edge Korean trends with a local twist to bring out the best in every customer.

name: ASICS
description: ASICS has been developing sports footwear and apparel for more than 50 years. In this time, innovation has been the key to our introduction of design philosophies that have revolutionised the world of sports. At our research and development centre in Kobe, Japan, we work in close collaboration with male and female athletes. Through our scientific approach we have strived to create highly innovative sports product solutions that our customers rely upon. Technologies, such as core GEL cushioning system and Flytefoam are renown for enabling the most comfortable and performance-enhancing footwear and apparel on the market, for athletes and active consumers alike. This innovative approach, based on scientific research and collaboration with athletes, has been central to our key objective: Producing innovative sports products solutions and technologies to help athletes and active consumers achieve their goals. Our company name, an acronym for the Latin phrase “Anima Sana In Corpore Sano”, meaning “Sound Mind In A Sound Body”, has shaped our destiny. It is the echo of our consistency, our innovation, our commitment to quality and our authenticity. Drop by at ASICS VivoCity or visit our website at www.asics.com.sg for more information.

name: Astons Specialities
description: ASTONS Specialities is a homegrown casual steakhouse renowned for its steaks and homely western cuisine, without the hefty price tags. Quality food coupled with a relaxing and cosy ambience is what comes to mind when you hear about ASTONS Specialities. Watch time slip away as you bask in good food with good company at our restaurants. Our main menu consists of steak, chicken, pork and seafood meals with most main courses served with two decadent side dishes of your choice, cold or hot. Popular items include our legendary steaks charbroiled to your preferred doneness, grillwork chicken chops that come in a myriad of flavours including hickory barbecue and chargrilled style and super combo meals such as surf & turf.

name: Auntie Anne's
description: Auntie Anne’s Singapore has been baking golden brown pretzels and making hand-squeezed lemonade since 1996. Each pretzel is lovingly handmade and oven-baked fresh on site in our stores everyday. With more than 20 different tastes, from sweet and savory to unique and flavourful, there’s one for everyone! Try our pretzels with our dips or fresh lemonade and passionfruit drinks to satisfy your cravings any time of day ~ Not hungry? Come by the store and witness our pretzel rolling in action! P.S. Auntie Anne’s products has no egg, no pork and is free of artificial preservatives and sweeteners 🙂

name: Aureus Academy
description: Aureus Academy specializes in providing individually tailored piano, violin, guitar and vocal lessons to students of all ages and abilities. We believe one-on-one is the best environment to learn a musical instrument, but the trick is keeping students engaged while making the lessons fun and rewarding! Our lessons are designed to engage each student in a way that suits their learning style. Book your FREE trial with us today!

name: Aureus Academy
description: Aureus Academy specializes in providing individually tailored piano, violin, guitar and vocal lessons to students of all ages and abilities. We believe one-on-one is the best environment to learn a musical instrument, but the trick is keeping students engaged while making the lessons fun and rewarding! Our lessons are designed to engage each student in a way that suits their learning style. Book your FREE trial with us today!

name: A&W
description: A&W Restaurants is a heritage fast-food brand known for its signature Root Beer, served in frosty mugs, and classic American favorites like Coney Dogs, Curly Fries, and Burgers. Founded in 1919 in California, A&W was the first successful franchise restaurant chain in the U.S. Today, it continues to delight fans across the globe with its nostalgic charm and timeless flavors. In Singapore, A&W blends its rich legacy with local tastes, offering a unique dining experience that appeals to both loyal fans and new generations.

name: Awfully Chocolate
description: In 1998, Awfully Chocolate started in Singapore with just the All Chocolate cake. Today, they have stores, cafes and restaurants in Singapore and abroad, and continue to wow with their inventive array of exciting chocolate creations. Enjoy the full, natural flavours of their cakes, ice cream and truffles, all made by hand from scratch. At their VivoCity café, a range of wholesome chocolate drinks made with our own sauces pair well with your warmed slice of Super Stacked cake and a scoop of hei ice cream. Welcome to the Awfully Chocolate life!

name: balabala
description: Balabala is a leading international children’s apparel and footwear brand established in 2002, to provide high-quality, fashionable products crafted with functional fabrics. Boasting an extensive retail footprint, the brand flourishes across over 4,800 stores worldwide, successfully captivating the hearts of customers in 30 countries and regions.

name: Barossa Bar & Grill
description: An Australian-inspired restaurant and bar where ‘outback meets chic’. Its unpretentious, laid-back and rustic ambience makes it the perfect place to chill out after a hard day’s work and tuck in hearty Australian fare created only with the freshest ingredients and premium grades of Australian beef.

name: Bata
description: Bata offers urban customers the best in today’s fashion footwear and accessories. The store provides a high level of customer service, exclusive fashion shoe lines with complementary accessories, and contemporary shopping environments to discerning shoppers.

name: Bath & Body Works
description: We make the world a brighter, happier place through the power of fragrance. Bath & Body Works is a global leader in personal care and home fragrance, including the #1 selling collections for fine fragrance mist, body lotion and body cream, 3-wick candles, home fragrance diffusers and liquid hand soap. Bath & Body Works serves and delights customers however and wherever they want to shop, from welcoming, in-store experiences at more than 8 stores operating in Singapore.

name: Battercatch
description: BatterCatch serves golden-battered fish with perfectly fried French fries, alongside a variety of seafood delights and hearty Western dishes. It is your go-to spot for timeless favourites that are both satisfying and delicious. Enjoy a taste of the coast in every bite!

name: BEARD PAPA'S
description: Founded in 1999 by Yuji Hirota in Fukuoka, Japan, Beard Papa’s set out to redefine the cream puff. Guided by a commitment to freshness, quality, and craftsmanship, Beard Papa’s strives to create the “world’s best cream puff,” freshly made with the finest ingredients. From its humble beginnings, Beard Papa’s has grown into a global phenomenon, sharing its signature cream puffs with customers worldwide through more than 500 outlets internationally.

name: BECOME AESTHETICS CLINIC
description: Experts in innovative anti-ageing Skin and Face solutions for a younger, better you. Pigment Removal, V Shape Face Lifting and more! Look and feel your best with Become Aesthetics Clinic Singapore.

name: Ben & Jerry's
description: Want to have your Ben & Jerry’s ice cream the way it was originally intended? Head to our VivoCity ice cream shop and dig into any of our euphoric ice cream flavors in the way the first scoops were served up by Ben and Jerry themselves back in 1978. Come enjoy a freshly baked waffle cone, shake or sundae with your favorite flavor. We also make delicious custom ice cream cake for any occasion, and we offer ice cream catering – where we bring the scoop shop experience to your office party, wedding or special event – anywhere across Singapore!

name: Benjamin Barker
description: Founded in 2009 in Melbourne, Australia, Benjamin Barker is a premium menswear brand created with the vision of bringing well-crafted and heritage‐inspired menswear to the masses. Innovative and progressive, the label is reinventing what defines traditional menswear as it continues to inject art and culture into the gentlemen’s outfitter it is today. A purveyor of smart-casual, heritage inspired apparel and a lifestyle destination for the discerning gentleman, Benjamin Barker pays tribute to the best of men’s fashion.

name: Best Denki
description: Best Denki provides a total solution to enhance the lifestyle of Singaporeans with the latest electrical appliances and gadgets from well-trusted brands such as Samsung, LG, Panasonic, Sony, Acer, and Asus. Come visit Best Denki for a wide selection of consumer electronics/home appliances for your electrical needs.

name: Billabong
description: Billabong began its long, amazing ride in 1973 on the Gold Coast of Australia. It all started with a single, humble pair of boardshorts and a crocheted bikini crafted on founder Gordon Merchant’s kitchen table. Today, Billabong is a leader in surf inspired apparel and accessories for men and women with one simple mission: to inspire youth through progressive surf culture.

name: Birds of Paradise Gelato Boutique
description: Birds of Paradise delights in creating botanical gelato, flavoured with beauty that nature has given to us – fruits, flowers, herbs, spices, nuts and pods. We draw inspiration from nature to create new, beautiful flavours and experiences. Enjoy a delicious botanically-flavoured cone at our gelato parlour.

name: Birkenstock
description: BIRKENSTOCK’S historical roots go all the way back to 1774. BIRKENSTOCK not only invented the footbed but also the word “footbed.” BIRKENSTOCK has been a global player since at least the late 1970s. In addition, BIRKENSTOCK also has a growing range of closed-toe, children´s, and work shoes as well as specialist products for orthopedic retailers.

name: SCARLETT 思家客
description: Scarlett Singapore redefines the Chinese grocery experience by bringing authentic flavors to the city. As a curated specialty supermarket, it offers an exceptional selection of traditional snacks, artisanal sauces, and delicacies across China. Each product is carefully chosen to represent both timeless classics and current culinary trends. Scarlett creates meaningful cultural connections through food, serving as a cherished destination for community gatherings and nostalgic discoveries. It stands as Singapore’s trusted bridge to China’s rich culinary heritage, where every visit brings new tastes and memories home.

name: BLÉ DE FONTY
description: Blé de Fonty, established in Singapore in 2016 by a team of INSEAD alumni, is a leading skincare brand known for its innovative ‘Miracle Pearls.’ These unique, serum-infused capsules cater to various skin types, blending superior quality, efficacy, and sustainability. Inspired by Fontainebleau wheat, Blé de Fonty offers a fresh, effective skincare line that promotes beauty globally, maintaining a commitment to sustainable, high-quality products.

name: Bliss Nest Capsules
description: BNC, a brand of freshly stewed bird’s nest specially designed to meet the needs of the local market. With a unique capsule bowl packaging that is lighter and safer allowing you to enjoy the highest-grade bird’s nest anytime, anywhere. Alongside a unique combination of mixing Bird’s Nest and beverage, BNC have also introduced never seen before beverages in Singapore to make your eating experience less monotonous. BNC – Bird’s Nest in a Bowl was born to reimagine and inspire different generations to enjoy bird’s nest. One nest one Capsule!

name: Boost Express
description: Boost Juice Bars is the place to be for an explosion of flavor and fun. Sip on sensational smoothies and tantalizing juices, crafted with love and bursting with freshness. With a brand history as cool as their drinks, Boost Juice Bars has become the trendsetter for health-conscious individuals. Their secret weapon? A kaleidoscope of vibrant concoctions that make taste buds dance.

name: Boost Juice
description: Australia’s #1 Juice & Smoothie bar is here in Singapore! Boost offers a healthy alternative to fast food. Their menu offers real fruit juices, crushes and delicious low-fat smoothies made with top secret TD4 (To Die For) low-fat frozen yogurt. All products are at least 98% fat-free and no artificial flavours, colours, sugar or water are added.

name: Bottles & Bottles
description: Bottles & Bottles is a homegrown wine retailer since 2004, boasting a wide variety of the finest wines worldwide. With a forte in being a mall retailer that reaches consumers directly with products that appeal to their lifestyles, the company has seen continued growth in the industry. Bottles & Bottles now has nine stores in Singapore and is a favourite amongst locals and tourists.

name: Braun Büffel
description: For over a century, Braun Büffel has remained an emblem of style, strength, and dependability, transcending its humble beginnings as a family trade in Kirn, Germany to become a renowned symbol of global recognition. With each meticulously crafted creation, Braun Büffel exemplifies unwavering craftsmanship, timeless appeal, and a rich legacy of excellence that continues to define the brand.

name: BreadTalk
description: A staple in the diet of many in Asia, honouring the art of bread-making by giving life to novel creations since 2000. BreadTalk is a distinctive, award-winning Singaporean brand that has gained international appeal for its signature Flosss. With the belief that every bun has life of its own and story to tell, BreadTalk is renowned for the way it has revolutionised the culture of bread consumption with creativity and innovation. At the heart of our brand, Flosss is an iconic product that has become synonymous with BreadTalk. Our range of breads goes far beyond Flosss, with exciting new products regularly added to our lineup.

name: Brotzeit German Bier Bar & Restaurant
description: Brotzeit® is a typical German expression – “Brot” being German for bread and “Zeit” for time referring to a cosy meal complemented by fresh beer. Brotzeit® German Restaurant and Bar is a homegrown brand conceived in 2006, offering authentic German cuisine and premium German beers in a contemporary and casual setting. Enjoy their famous crispy oven-roasted pork knuckle and proprietary sausages in the comfort of the restaurant, while drinking premium German beer and taking in the sights of VivoCity’s waterfront.

name: Bulgogi Syo
description: Get ready for a new dining concept brought to you by the K-BBQ Artisans at Seorae. We bring you Bulgogi Syo – a brand new dining experience where the Perfect Fire (Bul) and Perfect Meat (Gogi) comes together to offer you the Perfect Experience (Syo/Show).

name: Burberry
description: Burberry makeup and fragrance is a celebration of classic and effortless British beauty with an unexpected, innovative twist. Discover easy-to-use beauty products that leave your skin with an effortless glow and iconic fragrances. Every chic collection is inspired by signature house codes, the English landscape and runway collections.

name: Burger King
description: Welcome to the home of flame-grilled perfection! At Burger King®, great food starts with real ingredients—no preservatives, no artificial colourings, no MSG, and no additives. Indulge in the best-selling WHOPPER®, the velvety Double Mushroom Swiss, and the tender, juicy Tendergrill® Chicken, made with chicken thigh fillet. Pair your burger meals with irresistible sides like Onion Rings and Taro Turnover. Burger King® is definitely your go-to for bold flavours, trusted quality, and affordable meals, with all products in Singapore 100% certified Halal. Sink your teeth into Burger King’s juicy burgers now!

name: BYD
description: BYD by JC is Singapore’s newest authorised BYD dealership, recognised for customer service excellence and family-oriented experiences. Strategically located in one of Singapore’s busiest malls, BYD VivoCity offers an immersive way to explore BYD’s innovative EVs in a vibrant, family-friendly environment. With bundled experiences alongside mall partners and our commitment to service, the new showroom makes switching to electric mobility easier, more exciting, and accessible for everyone. Guided by our tagline, “Your Journey, Our Commitment,” we deliver more than cars: we deliver a lifestyle shaped around innovation, convenience, and community.

name: Cakebar
description: At Cakebar, every cake is a handcrafted delight, made with premium ingredients and heartfelt care. From baking to design, our passionate artisans create treats that taste as good as they look. Whether you’re treating yourself or someone special, it’s where gifting meets sweet bliss, perfect for any occasion worth celebrating.

name: Calvin Klein
description: Calvin Klein is a global lifestyle brand that exemplifies bold, progressive ideals and a seductive aesthetic. They seek to thrill and inspire the audience while using provocative imagery and striking designs to ignite the senses.

name: Candy Empire
description: Candy Empire’s flagship store at VivoCity is much more than a one-stop-shop for anyone with a sweet tooth. It is a specialty shop filled with gourmet delights from across the world. Expect to find novelty chocolates, cookies, candies, spreads and confectionery treats sourced from quality manufacturers in Australia, Europe and the U.S.A – a paradise for snack lovers and perfect for gifting occasions.

name: Canton Paradise+ 樂天小香港小品
description: Born from the love of Hong Kong’s bustling food scene, Canton Paradise+ offers all-day H.K. style dim sum, congee and H.K. noodle, lovingly handmade and thoughtfully presented. Indulge in the authentic taste of Hong Kong, crafted meticulously with creativity.

name: Cedele
description: Cedele is a food and beverage chain with over 30 outlets in Singapore and specialises in handmade, artisan baked goods. At the heart of Cedele, they strive to uphold the ethos “Eat Well, Be Well”. Their food is honest and wholesome, and they take the care to select the freshest natural ingredients, giving you a peace of mind when you dine.

name: CFC Chicken
description: Cluckfry Chicken (CFC), founded in 2024, is a HK Style fried chicken brand that brings old-school Hong Kong street flavours into today’s culture. Inspired by classic street-side recipe, our chicken is layered with garlic aroma, savoury notes, and a hint of natural sweetness, crispy outside, tender inside, and bursting with juiciness. More than just fried chicken, CFC represents a free, fun, and inclusive lifestyle built around bold flavour and shared enjoyment.

name: CHAGEE
description: CHAGEE is an international tea brand that brings traditional tea to modern life. Drawing from centuries of tea heritage, we craft premium whole-leaf brews that blend tradition with innovation — creating shared moments of connection, every day, in every cup. CHAGEE TOGETHER.

name: Challenger
description: Challenger is a dynamic regional IT retailer known for its strong brand name and attractive ValueClub membership privileges. They deliver every day value to their members on the latest IT gadgets and lifestyle products.

name: CHANEL
description: In the world of CHANEL fragrance, makeup and skincare, avant-garde products interact with legendary creations to bring the promise of a unique beauty that is enhanced each and every day. Discover the creative spirit of CHANEL through its exclusive events and collections all year ’round at VivoCity.

name: Charles & Keith
description: Fashion entrepreneurs, Charles and Keith Wong founded CHARLES & KEITH in 1996 upon identifying the potential of footwear designs catered for Asian women. Today, CHARLES & KEITH is the go-to fashion destination for stylish urbanites, recognised for its accessible fashion and curated collections of relevant designs. A lifestyle brand that embraces a culture of innovation, it has developed a full-fledged line of footwear, bags, eyewear, accessories and costume jewellery. The brand has established a presence in prominent fashion cities such as Seoul, Shanghai and Dubai and continues to inspire with its experimental and unparalleled designs.

name: Cheers
description: Officially launched in 1998, Cheers is a home grown chain of convenience stores that serves a diverse group of customers who value convenience and time. Cheers has since expanded to over 150 outlets situated across Singapore at convenient locations.

name: Chimichanga
description: Established in 2016, Chimichanga stands as one of the pioneering casual Mexican eateries, injecting zest into the dining scene. Nestled by the waterfront, it offers a delectable array of hearty bites, from Tacos to Quesadillas and Chimichangas, all savoured against the scenic backdrop of Sentosa. The menu extends to sophisticated options like seafood and meat platters, ensuring a delightful experience for solo diners or larger gatherings. Portion sizes cater to all appetites, complemented by a diverse cocktail selection, featuring signature Frozen Margaritas and their house craft beer, Neon Donkey Cerveza. At Chimichanga, every visit promises a satisfying blend of flavours and views.

name: Chloé Atelier des Fleurs
description: The House of Chloé unveils a collection of seventeen fragrances celebrating the art of floral composition with Chloé Atelier des Fleurs. Compose your personalised fragrance just as you compose a bouquet at the florist, with fragrances designed to work in harmony in endless combinations. Each fragrance can live alone, in pairs, or in threes, adding its own distinctive facet: green or spicy, fresh or honeyed, musky or powdery. Play with any combination imaginable to find your unique accord. The perfect accord. Discover the full Atelier des Fleurs experience, with exclusive events and collections at VivoCity.

name: Chou Niang Jiu Niang 丑娘酒酿
description: Chouniang Jiuniang is Singapore’s first and only freshly brewed jiuniang (fermented rice wine) brand, blending traditional Chinese heritage with modern wellness. Officially launched in 2023, the brand crafts additive-free, nutrient-rich beverages and desserts that celebrate the nostalgic flavors of jiuniang. With innovative offerings like Jiuniang Iced Dew and Snow Mochi, Chouniang appeals to health-conscious consumers and trend-seeking youth alike. From its flagship Orchard Road outlet to expansion across Singapore, Chouniang is redefining fermented drinks with authenticity, freshness, and emotional resonance.

name: CHOW TAI FOOK
description: Founded in 1929, CHOW TAI FOOK has been widely recognised for its trustworthiness and authenticity, and is renowned for its product design, quality and value. To meet different consumer needs, CHOW TAI FOOK offers a better customer experience also a wide variety of products, services and channels for different lifestyles and personalities, as well as customers’ important life stages.

name: Clarks
description: Clarks is a global brand with a firm dedication to originality and quality in every aspect of their DNA. After nearly 200 years of brilliant ideas and ground-breaking innovation, every pair of shoes they make still begins and ends with the same thing – Craftsmanship

name: Click – Photo Ideas
description: Click-Photo Ideas is your one-stop destination for professional imaging and document solutions. Click-Photo Ideas provide a comprehensive suite of services including professional passport photography, large-format printing up to A0, photocopying, lamination, and binding. Beyond functional printing, they also specialize in high-quality personalized gifts such as canvas prints, metal plate printing, photobooks, and custom company stamps.

name: Coach
description: The store, designed by the Coach architecture group, is a 1,070 square footspace reflecting the Soho design concept. An assortment of Coach’s products allows shoppers to appreciate the variety, detail and quality of Coach offering while getting an overview of the company’s lifestyle approach.

name: COLLIN'S®
description: A celebration of passion, for the craft of good food and great service to our guests. Established since 2012, COLLIN’S® is one of Singapore’s leading restaurant chains that brings premium Western cuisine to the masses. Using the language of food, COLLIN’S® seek to bring families, friends and loved ones closes as they gather and indulge in good food and company. With a wide selection of great grills, succulent meats, woodfired pizzas and carefully selected wine/beverage list, COLLIN’S® offers an extensive menu that is curated to delight customers from all walks of life. Today, Chef Collin and his team continues to innovate its offerings to ensure the brand stays fresh and relevant in the market.

name: CONNOR
description: Discover CONNOR, Australia’s largest menswear retailer, now bringing effortless style to Singapore. Born to Australia, CONNOR is known for delivering quality menswear that fits every moment of a man’s lifestyle – from relaxed casualwear to sharp, smart looks. Whether it’s everyday essentials, weekend outfits or event-ready dressing, CONNOR makes it easy to look good and feel confident. With a focus on great design, comfort, and seriously good value , CONNOR offers style made easy for every event.

name: COS
description: COS offers a wardrobe of ready-to-wear and accessories for a life well dressed. Rooted in luxury design and compelling fashion movements, the collection pays meticulous attention to sustainable craftsmanship, quality and a superior colour palette that transcends time. The creative soul of the brand is visualised through original storytelling, seasonal runway shows and contemporary culture to create an experience beyond the expected.

name: Cotton On Kids
description: Cotton On Kids is the cool kids of kids’ fashion, creating fun from head to toe. We make kids the star of the show, creating easy outfits that bring their big dreams and wild imaginations to life.

name: Cotton On
description: Cotton On is a global fashion and lifestyle brand that empowers people to look, feel and be the best version of themselves. Creating everyday products to make everyday experiences better.

name: COUPLE LAB
description: Couple Lab Jewellery is a custom jewelry store that provides laser engraving services to make life’s special occasions a lasting memory. We are dedicated to crafting bespoke accessories which will bring happiness to the wearer, whether it’s a fashion style or tale-telling accessory. We understand that every piece made has a sentimental story behind it. Founded over a decade ago, we design and manufacture jewelry collections such as rings, necklaces, cufflinks, bracelets, bangles, and keychains. Our collection is constantly expanding as we strive to provide innovative and creative jewelry options.

name: Crocodile
description: Established in 1947, Crocodile is an international fashion and lifestyle brand that delivers timeless, quality and functional wear with men’s garments having been the initial core of the brand. From the beginning of a single product, Crocodile diversified into other product ranges including footwear, leather goods, travel ware, timepiece, eyewear, bedding and other accessories for men, ladies and children. Crocodile is Singapore’s only garment brand built upon a long and illustrious history. It continues to carve new milestones today.

name: crocs
description: A world leader in innovative casual footwear for men, women and children. Crocs offers several distinct shoe collections with more than 300 footwear styles, from the iconic clog to new sneakers, sandals, boots and heels. All Crocs™ shoes feature Croslite™ material, a proprietary, revolutionary technology that gives each pair of shoes the soft, comfortable, lightweight and odor-resistant qualities that Crocs fans know and love. Since its inception in 2002, Crocs has sold more than 200 million pairs of shoes in more than 90 countries around the world.

name: Crystal Jade Pavilion
description: Celebrating joyous family banquets and casual social gatherings with modern interpretation of classic Chinese dishes. Inspiring and delighting diners with delicious, healthy and innovative food in a bright, contemporary ambiance.

name: Da Paolo Gastronomia
description: Gastronomia was born out of the desire to make great-tasting food easily and readily available to anyone, even the busiest of the lot. A gourmet concept combining cafe and retail, Gastronomia offers a wide array of freshly made food and imported fine foods from Europe.

name: Daiso Japan
description: DAISO is a mega store established in Japan in 1977. We are Japan’s no. 1 ranking living ware supplier, with 2800 stores across the country and 860 stores in 26 nations worldwide. With over 90,000 different products in our inventory and a further 1,000 new products being developed each month, they provide the most variety and value for all your needs.

name: Dancing Crab
description: A dining experience unlike any other: fresh seafood, lively music, a cocktail and whiskey bar, and much more! Backed by one of Singapore’s oldest seafood restaurant leaders, TungLok Group, Dancing Crab sources their shellfish from the same vendors used at the group’s best seafood restaurants, offering a range from Boston lobster to Dungeness crab.

name: DaXi Taiwan Noodle & Dumpling
description: DaXi brings the best of Taiwanese cuisine to your table. Delight in our freshly handmade Signature Dumplings, packed with flavorful fillings and cooked to perfection. Beyond dumplings, indulge in a wide array of Taiwanese favorites, from savory Braised Dishes to hearty Noodle mains, creamy Scrambled Egg Rice, and more. Every dish is crafted to give you a true taste of Taiwan!

name: DBS ATM & DBS Cash Deposit Machine
DENIM D'Artisan
description: Exquisitely crafted denim together with high street fashion now available at Denim D’ Artisan! To pique your interest with intriguing denim pieces, Denim D’ Artisan is the destination of satisfaction for denim lovers! We’re also the exclusive appointed Nudie Jeans Official Repair Partner in 🇸🇬, fully equipped to handle your repairs in all types of ways for FREE! Visit us for all your denim needs!

name: Dental on the Bay
description: Your smile, your life, their passion. At Dental On The Bay, they are dedicated to provide you with quality dental care and services. Equipped with the latest state-of-the-art technology and comprehensive personalized service, you can be assured of remarkable results.

name: Desigual
description: Desigual is characterised by its different, optimistic and colourful designs. The company began operating in 1984. “La Vida es Chula” (Life is Cool) is Desigual’s slogan and way of looking at fashion and life. It’s an enthusiastic, positive and optimistic message that truly nails its colours to the mast. The fashion brand has five product categories: WOMAN, MAN, ACCESSORIES, SHOES and SPORT and 17 distribution channels.

name: Diamond2®
description: Our revolutionary lab-grown Diamond2® is an innovative breakthrough that seeks to disrupt the tradition-bound world of fine jewellery dominated by the mined diamonds. Our unique, lab-grown diamonds are designed to seduce today’s sophisticated, forward-looking clientele, thanks to its rarefied beauty and remarkable brilliance that equals that of mined diamonds but at significantly lesser cost. Discover the beauty of Diamond2® . Discover a world beyond mined diamonds.

name: Dian Xiao Er 店小二 (新加坡药材烤鸭)
description: Since its inception in 2002, Dian Xiao Er has grown into one of the most renowned household names in Singapore – famed for its Herbal Roast Ducks and mouth-watering specials such as the Pan-Fried Cod Fish and Wheatgrass Tofu. The brand prides itself on dishing out nutritious and balanced quality meals, which explains a menu brimming with a wide array of meat, seafood, and vegetables. A meal at Dian Xiao Er is reminiscent of a taste of home.

name: Din Tai Fung
description: Recognised by The New York Times as one of the world’s Top Ten Best Restaurants, Din Tai Fung traces its origins to Taiwan over 60 years ago. Renowned for their signature Steamed Pork Xiao Long Bao and Steamed Chicken Soup, Din Tai Fung has since expanded internationally, with a presence in Singapore, Thailand, the UK, Australia, China, Indonesia, Japan, Malaysia, the Philippines, South Korea, the UAE, and the USA.

name: DipnDip
description: Chocolate lovers, you’re in for a treat. dipndip is the ultimate chocolate café that has been bringing smiles to over 140 branches in 18 countries worldwide. Founded in 2009, dipndip was created by two friends who had a love for chocolate and one goal… to make people smile! Indulge in dipndip’s chocolate-based desserts and beverages, such as their signature Mighty Crepes, Mighty Milkshakes and Fettuccine Crepe. Satisfaction is always on the menu!

name: DJI
description: Creativity is at the heart of every dream. Every idea, every groundbreaking leap that changes our world starts with the vision of talented creators. At DJI, we give these creators the tools they need to bring their ideas to life. Established to produce DJI’s innovative products safely and responsibly, our wholly owned subsidiary Shenzhen Dajiang Baiwang Technology Co., Ltd. is a high-tech manufacturing facility specializing in unmanned aerial vehicles.

name: DOUGH MAGIC 扑面而来
description: Dough Magic (扑面而来) is a Singapore-born modern heritage brand. Founded in 2016, the brand began with a clear and heartfelt vision: to bring the forgotten richness of Chinese handcrafted pastries back into everyday life—across cultures, generations, and global cities. Since then, Dough Magic has grown into a beloved presence across the island, with over 20 outlets drawing steady crowds of both locals and visitors. Known for its freshly made Mantou, dumplings, xiaolongbao, and savoury pastries, the brand blends authentic culinary techniques with a modern sensibility—offering heritage flavours in a form that feels current, accessible, and beautifully understated.

name: Dr. Lash
description: DR. LASH specialises in eyelash extensions, lash perming, lash rejuvenation, eyebrow henna, eyebrow embroidery, and facials. Well received by the public and a winner of multiple beauty awards, we endeavour to provide the highest standards in service and treatments, and aims to be in the leading name for eyelash extensions in Asia. After just one visit to DR. LASH, you will notice the difference in the quality, look and longevity of our lashes compared to most other salons.

name: Dyson
description: Today, there are Dyson machines in over 65 countries around the world. Dyson has grown from one man and one idea to a technology company with over 1,000 engineers worldwide. But it does not stand still. At its core is an ever-growing team of engineers and scientists. More ideas. More invention. Dyson technology works differently, it is engineered to solve real problems. Discover Dyson’s full range of floorcare, purification, hair care and lighting technology. Find the right machine for you with the help of Dyson experts.

name: Eat Pizza
description: Hailing from South Korea, EatPizza serves up piping hot pizzas made fresh to order in just 5 minutes. Our 25cm rectangular pizzas are designed for grab-and-go convenience—easy to enjoy solo with one hand or perfect for sharing multiple flavors with friends. With over 10 enticing variations, favorites include Sweet Potato Pizza, Crispy Potato Bacon Pizza, and our signature Hot Spicy Chicken Pizza. Made with high-protein dough, extra virgin olive oil, 100% natural cheese, and fresh ingredients, EatPizza delivers quality, flavor, and convenience in every slice.

name: ECCO
description: ECCO is one of the world’s leading shoe brands, combining style and comfort since 1963.

name: EICHITOO
description: EICHITOO is a lady wear brand. Founded in 2010, EICHITOO had an enormous impact on fashion industry by infusing cultural aesthetic elements into modern fashion to create a distinctive fashion trend. The products are divided into three series: urban life, urban office and urban fashion. EICHITOO — stylish yet subtle, simple yet refined, chic yet infused with a classical touch. Under the value price quality and service, EICHITOO with its urban elegance, popular color and unique design has won the favor and pursuit of the majority of modern lady.

name: ELEVATIONE™
description: ÉLÉVATIONE, a leading international Boutique experience brand, that was born from the idea that beauty goes beyond skin deep, and radiates even more than an aura. ÉLÉVATIONE believes beauty is a concept, a construct, and a method of expression. Beauty is art, art is beauty, and the ÉLÉVATIONE woman is a masterpiece.

name: eLITe SUPPLEMENTS
description: Australia’s No.1 supplement retailer is now in Singapore, with its second store at VivoCity! Elite Supplements offers premium sports nutrition and fitness products, including protein powders, pre-workouts, BCAAs, vitamins, and recovery essentials. Featuring top international brands like Emrald Labs, Lunar Performance, Ghost, Optimum Nutrition, and EHP Labs, Elite Supplements empowers athletes and fitness enthusiasts to reach their health and performance goals with quality, variety, and expert guidance.

name: Encik Tan
description: Recognising the demand from our Muslim counterparts for authentic Chinese hawker fare, the Encik Tan brand was introduced as a Halal-certified mini food atrium concept that dishes up a parade of popular local Chinese dishes, such as Hainanese Curry Rice, Wanton Noodles and Claypot Rice. All recipes are adapted using Halal ingredients and fine-tuned to deliver the same nostalgic flavour and taste of the original dishes. Encik Tan ensures that every dining experience is a flavourful journey that delights all. Encik Tan offers a pleasant dining experience, complete with air conditioning for added comfort.

name: Eu Yan Sang
description: Founded in 1879, Eu Yan Sang is Asia’s leading brand in the healthcare industry, with a core focus in traditional Chinese medicine. The products offered include a wide selection of fine quality Chinese herbs, Chinese Proprietary medicines as well as health foods and supplements. Their top-selling products are bottled bird’s nest and flagship Bak Foong Pills. Eu Yan Sang’s continuous commitment to expand the reach and benefits of its’ products and services towards lifelong good health for all has seen it span across Singapore in major shopping malls and residential estates today.

name: Everbest
description: Everbest Shoes & Handbags Pte Ltd was established in 1979 by the creator of the brand EVERBEST. Our brand is the first local shoe brand known for our ladies comfort executive footwear and classic sleek men footwear. Everbest has over the years evolves to bring more exciting range of shoes. We have expanded our collection over time and moving forward to bring in a wide variety of styles, ranging from comfort to high fashion collection in line with the current trend.

name: EX STYLE
description: EX Style Prestige aims to provide luxurious yet affordable services through a team of highly experienced and innovative professionals. Teamwork is our most valued asset which ensures our customers are always top priority, and we strive to exceed your expectations.

name: Fabindia
description: Fabindia’s store in Singapore at VivoCity presents the very best from the brand, with its curated collection of Indian inspired womens wear, mens wear, personal accessories, giftware and range of home furnishings. Each piece is “natural and crafted” as per the ethos of the company set up in India, by American, John Bissell, who was deeply inspired by Indian fabrics and created Fabindia. Today, Fabindia boasts a 50 year history of producing organic, affordable and beautifully crafted products using age old techniques and hand based processes.

Don’t just take our word for it, the only way to feel the FitFlop difference is to live your life in our shoes!

name: Flipper's
description: Flipper’s is a Japanese café well known for its light and fluffy souffle pancakes made fresh to order. Beyond our signature sweets, we offer a variety of savoury dishes including meal pancakes, dashi pasta, baked rice, omurice, and wagyu hamburg. Using quality ingredients such as farm-fresh eggs, wheat, milk, and butter, every dish is crafted with care. Embracing our “Egg Farm to Table” philosophy, Flipper’s brings wholesome, heartwarming, and delightful dining experiences to everyone.

name: Food Republic
description: Comprising over 30 stalls and mini restaurants meticulously hand-picked for their traditional tastes and flavours, this 27,000 sq ft food atrium offers nostalgic glimpses of life in the early 1900s. The interiors feature touches such as time-weathered floor tiles and memorabilia such as a Chinese sedan chair for some old world charm.

name: Foot Locker
description: When it comes to celebrating sneaker culture, no one does it better than Foot Locker. With a history of more than 40 years, Foot Locker offers the best selection of global brands under one roof – Nike, Jordan, adidas, Puma, Converse, New Balance, Vans, Under Armour, and streetwear brands including HUF, Rip N Dip, Daily Paper, Carrots and Yeti. Its athletic-inspired sneakers and apparel are guaranteed to make you stand out in the crowd.

name: Fragrance
description: Inspired by the fervour and optimism of the newly independent Singapore, Madam Ong set up her first bakkwa stall in 1969. Through hard work, she developed winning formula, and the heavenly scent of her barbecued meat attracted Singaporeans from all walks of life. Fragrance 香味is named after the natural aroma of the barbecued meat and is built on the foundations of quality, progress, trust and customer satisfaction. Our products are manufactured in Singapore based on time-honoured recipes, using only the highest quality of ingredients to ensure our products maintain their consistency and conform to the highest hygiene standards.

name: Fruit Paradise
description: Fruit Paradise offers fruit tarts made with lightly sweetened cream topped with fresh fruits. The fruit tarts are made with only the freshest and most delicious fruits, carefully selected by Japanese Patissiers every day. Enjoy the fruits’ natural goodness, free of unhealthy additives and preservatives.

name: FUN CLAW
description: FunClaw offers a premium claw machine experience featuring exclusive high-quality toys, immersive gameplay, and a welcoming environment. Our innovative “Double Joy” rewards program ensures that every successful catch is doubly rewarding. Beyond gameplay, we are a vibrant community hub where families, friends, and like-minded individuals can connect and create lasting memories. Join us at FunClaw and experience unparalleled entertainment.

name: Future State
description: FUTURE STATE is an expression of the modern, cosmopolitan woman with her own unique sense of style. Collecting inspirations from all over the world, FUTURE STATE designs are a breath of fresh air, capturing the essence of contemporary feminine beauty through vibrant colors, unique prints, exquisite detail and classic timeless pieces. Our dresses and tops are lovingly made with carefully chosen fabrics and can be paired with our range of bags and accessories.

name: G-Shock Casio
description: G-SHOCK Casio, operated by Casio Singapore Pte Ltd, features the latest and most comprehensive timepieces and houses brands such as G-SHOCK, BABY-G, EDIFICE, SHEEN OCEANUS & PROTREK. Consumers can also look out for exclusives, such as limited edition G-SHOCK, EDIFICE & BABY-G.

name: G2000
description: G2000 is the savvy executive’s choice that takes business to a personal level, providing easy-to-wear trends and updated classics with an Asian fit. Flaunt your individual style with a versatile range of work wear and smart essentials that offers a balance of tailored elegance and sharp style, taking you from 9 to 5 and beyond.

name: Gain City
description: Established in 1981, Gain City started out with a simple quest of improving lifestyles and a focused vision to be Singapore’s trusted air-conditioner retailer. Today, renowned as Singapore’s largest air-conditioner retailer, the brand is synonymous with excellent air-conditioning installation and maintenance service, as well as being the preferred go-to 1-Stop retailer for consumer electronics. With more than 800 staff, a pool of BCA-certified installation technicians and a fleet of over 180 service vehicles, they are your trusted choice.

name: Garrett Popcorn Shops
description: Garrett Popcorn Shops® – A Chicago Tradition from the USA since 1949 For over seven decades, Garrett Popcorn Shops has served gourmet popcorn using wholesome ingredients in their secret family recipes, passed down for generations. Custom grown, non-GMO butterfly and mushroom kernels are first hot-air popped in their kitchens, then enriched with flavor in seasoned, old-fashioned Copper Kettles. Because good things take time, Garrett Popcorn is handcrafted in small batches throughout the day. Signature recipes include the fan-invented, original Chicago-style popcorn, Chicago Mix®, which blends the sweetness of CaramelCrisp™ with the savory goodness of CheeseCorn; plus Buttery (a vegan treat!), Plain, CheeseCorn, CaramelCrisp, Almond CaramelCrisp and Macadamia CaramelCrisp. Like no other™, Garrett Popcorn enchants adoring fans around the world.

name: Genki Sushi
description: With over 20 outlets islandwide, Genki Sushi Singapore is never far from your next sushi fix! Powered by our iconic Kousoku Express delivery system, your favourite plates zoom straight to your table, fast, fresh, and always fun. Paired with our seamless BYOD ordering system, every visit turns into a uniquely playful dining adventure that Genki fans can’t get enough of. Feeling the sushi cravings already? Catch us at Genki Sushi, right around the corner!

name: GG
description: Narrowing the generation gap (GG) is the philosophy behind GG<5. Established in 1997, GG<5 is a contemporary fashion brand built upon confident individuals that explore dressing as an everyday experience, both ordinary & imaginative.

name: Giraffa
description: Giraffa is a famous bakery from Kamakura, Japan, known for its signature Japanese Curry Cheese Bread — a deep-fried milk bun filled with rich curry and melted mozzarella cheese. The curry blends over 30 spices with beef, pork, honey, apples, tomatoes, and wine for a balanced, flavorful taste. Each bun is crispy outside, soft inside, bursting with umami. Winner of the Japanese Golden Curry Bread Award three years in a row, Giraffa brings this beloved Japanese snack to Singapore, delivering warmth and unforgettable flavor in every bite.

name: Go-Ang Pratunam Chicken Rice
description: Established in 1960 as a food stall specialising in Hainanese chicken rice in the Pratunam district of Bangkok, Go-Ang Kaomunkai Pratunam quickly gained popularity among locals. Today, the brand is synonymous with the area, and from 2018 to 2020, the popular eatery was awarded a prestigious Michelin Bib Gourmand Award in the Bangkok edition of Michelin Guide. At Go-Ang Pratunam Chicken Rice, savour Thai-style chicken rice that is best paired with its homemade chilli sauce together with other side dishes and soups, creating the familiar communal dining experience synonymous with Singapore.

name: Go Noodle House
description: Go Noodle House has lived up to its expectation as one of the best noodle restaurants to serve soup Mi Xian Noodles. One of the top most favourite choice of noodle bowl is the Signature Bursting Meatball Mi Xian. The burst in your mouth will blow your mind and pairing with delicious broth that comes from a tinge of the premium ShaoXing HuaDiao wine is quite essential in bringing out the distinctive taste, which only in GO Noodle House. While quality is never compromised, quantity is another factor that will leave you full, satisfied and most importantly with a smile.

name: Golden Village
description: Golden Village Multiplex opened GV VivoCity, its ninth flagship and the largest cinema complex in Singapore on 7 October 2006. GV VivoCity houses GVmax – the ultimate big screen experience in a gigantic, stadium-like auditorium with 602 seats and one of the widest screens in Asia, 3 Gold Class cinemas and 11 new stadium cinemas. In November 2012, Golden Village, together with Dolby Laboratories launched Dolby’s latest new cinema sound format, Dolby® Atmos™, at its largest cinema hall, GVmax®. Golden Village’s GVmax® radial stadium seating, with one of its widest cinema screen in Asia is now accompanied by a crystal-clear 4K digital projection. For general enquiries, kindly email us at support@goldenvillage.com.sg.

name: Goldheart
description: Goldheart celebrates the woman who is passionate about life and embraces all the joy and richness it brings. Each piece of their fine jewellery reflects this. As the leading bridal jeweller in Singapore, Goldheart is the one that introduced the concept of wedding bands in white gold and platinum and making it mainstream locally. They are also the exclusive distributor of Celestial diamond, the world’s first 73-facet starburst diamond that scintillates with the supreme luminosity of the brightest star. Discover Goldheart’s fine jewellery, it’s your time to shine.

name: GOLDLION
description: Dr. Hon. Tsang Hin Chi founded Goldlion in 1968 and translated his passion for fine menswear and leather goods into the brand’s DNA, focusing on providing elegant and timeless menswear styles for successful and respectable men. Goldlion neck ties gained recognition for their premium quality since the 1970s and soared in popularity as the best gifts for men. The brand’s progress over the years brought new inspirations while never forgetting our commitment to quality craftsmanship and design. Every detail is taken cared of to ensure our products are of unparalleled fit and made with the Asian man in mind.

name: Gong Yuan Ma La Tang
description: At Gong Yuan Ma La Tang, soup matters! We love it when you leave our bowls ‘cleaned’. More than just soups, you can actually drink the Ma-La!

name: GRATiAE
description: Organic skincare from GRATiAE bestow ladies with Beauty, Health and Grace since the Roman ages. Housing the largest indoor organic Ferris wheel with greens, GRATiAE’s flagship store at VivoCity offers the complete experiential organic skincare retail experience as we offer solutions from skin renewal, anti-aging all the way to organic magnetic facial masks and more for optimal youth maintenance and intense hydration. Enjoy a complimentary hand treatment from us as a much-welcomed break from extensive shopping as you immerse yourself in our green and organic shop ambiance. Our knowledgeable skincare consultants will not disappoint. See you soon!

name: GUZMAN Y GOMEZ
description: At Guzman y Gomez, our passion is creating delicious 100% clean Mexican food using only the best ingredients. Try the GYG Mexican food experience in Singapore today!

name: Gyogyo
description: Features an extensive range of quality fish sets grilled to order. Choose from a huge selection of tastes and textures including Saikyo Yaki (西京焼き), Teriyaki (照り焼き), Shioyaki (塩焼き), Nitsuke (煮付け) and Foil Yaki complemented by the best choice of Japanese rice and miso soup. Apart from grilled dishes, the Sukiyaki Gozen (set meal of Japanese rice or udon with sides) and Japanese rice bowls are also not to be missed.

name: Gyu-Kaku
description: LET THE MAGIC OF YAKINIKU MAKE YOU HAPPY! WE BELIEVE IN THE POWER OF YAKINIKU SINCE OUR BEGINNING. We at Gyu-Kaku take pride in bringing you authentic ‘Yakiniku’ (Japanese BBQ) experience. We serve premium ‘Japanese Wagyu’ and many other quality food items at reasonable prices. Our menus include mouth-watering appetisers, fresh salad, tantalising seafood items, desserts, beverages, and so much more. Visit us for that exquisite taste of Japan, served to you at your table!

name: HaiDiLao HotPot
description: HaiDiLao is committed to bringing you a perfect integration of both traditional Sichuan style hot pot and the modern trendy dining habit. They want to spread the healthier hot spot culture to foodies all over the world, to provide a pleasant dining atmosphere and to share its delicious taste.

name: Han Flowers
description: Amidst the fleeting passage of time, HAN FLOWERS choose to preserve the bloom. Founded in 2006, HAN FLOWERS began its journey in China and has since blossomed across the globe. For nearly two decades, they have been devoted to the art of transforming ephemeral moments into lasting beauty. By sourcing the world’s finest flowers and handcrafting each creation with care and intention, HAN FLOWERS give form to emotions that deserve to endure. This is more than a craft—it is their way of conversing with time, allowing beauty to linger far beyond the moment it was born.

name: SERVUS German Burger Grill
description: SERVUS elevates the humble burger into a never-boring, healthy, nutritious and delicious meal – with something special for everyone. We want you to relax as soon as you step into our forest-themed Burger grill, whether in the company of family or friends, for business, romance, or even for some alone time. Hence, special attention has gone to interior design, lighting and music to create the feel-good ambience.

name: Henri Charpentier
description: A Japanese patisserie, founded in Ashiya City, Japan, in 1969. Henri Charpentier offer delicious fresh cakes (slices and whole), freshly baked financiers available in assorted flavours and .beautifully packaged gift boxes from Japan, suited for any occasion.For reservations or queries, please reach them at 6221 0093.

name: HEYTEA
description: Originated from a lane in China called ‘Jiangbianli’, HEYTEA was born from an instant inspiration of mixing cheese with tea. From a 20㎡ store to more than 600 outlets across Asia today, HEYTEA strives to serves drinks made with originality and ingenuity, hoping to spark inspiration in customers through every sip. With the finest tea sourced globally, HEYTEA hopes to breathe new life into the traditional tea culture. Our original bestselling drinks include: Very Grape Cheezo, Strawberry Cheezo, Mango Cheezo, Grapefruit Boom, the Bobo Family and Cheezo Tea series.

name: Himalayan Salt Spa by GRATiAE
description: Book a pamper date with this unique spa escape! The Himalayan Salt Spa is the perfect excuse to forget the rest of the world and bask in tranquility. Enjoy a session in specially curated Salt Rooms, and indulge in the healing effects of salt therapy. The Himalayan Salt Spa brand and experience was founded by GRATiAE, with their expertise in organic beauty solutions. Sink into blissful relaxation, and indulge in treatments designed to improve overall health and wellness by relieving stress and fatigue. Leave the spa rejuvenated and focused every time.

name: H&M
description: Welcome to H&M, your shopping destination for fashion. Discover the latest trends and wide range of Ladies, Mens and Kids apparels in high quality clothing at the best price in this store!

name: Hokkaido-Ya
description: Hokkaido-Ya is a new fast casual eatery serving Hokkaido-inspired dishes and Japanese favourites using premium ingredients. Opened in June 2018 by the team behind established Sushi Tei Pte Ltd, Hokkaido-Ya hopes to cater to wider audiences with their brand of Japanese hospitality, advanced ordering technology and good quality meals at wallet-friendly prices.

name: Hundred Grains 百米香
description: Immerse yourself in the vibrant and welcoming ambience of Hundred Grains, where a spectrum of flavours from Sichuan, Hunan and Guangdong provinces in China coalesce to delight your palate. We are now offering all-day dining and are thrilled to introduce our very first breakfast buffet at our VivoCity outlet. Our menu features freshly ground homemade Soy Milk and a selection of signature dishes, including Steamed Flower Buns and Brown Sugar Steamed Buns, Tea Eggs, etc —delicacies that are rarely found in Singapore. For lunch and dinner, we offer an extensive menu offering 60-80 dishes complemented by free-flow beverages, staples, fruits and desserts and our food is well-liked by people of all ages. Patrons have the luxury to peruse, select and pay based on their prefered portion size, making every dish an invitation to explore. The chef’s top picks include the Pearl Meatballs, Mala Chicken Wings and Home-stlye stir-fried Pork. For adventurous gourmets, there are the Pig’s Ears in Chilli oil, Spicy Chicken Cubes paired with pig’s intestine and Cold-tossed Beef Tripe. Your culinary journey continues with a variety of dishes like the Sweet and Sour Spare Ribs, Mingfu ribbon fish, and the classic Chong Qing Spicy Chicken. With our good food and a friendly atmosphere and comfortable setting, we look forward to making your every visit a memorable one.

name: HYSSES
description: HYSSES is a premium aromatherapy house that carries a treasure trove of essential oils, scent diffusers and accessories, face and body care products. Respecting Nature’s wisdom, HYSSES ventures to the many corners of the earth to handpick ingredients from their indigenous sources, where they are produced in naturally optimum environments. Each HYSSES product carries pieces of history and culture through its use of exotic ingredients, thoughtful design, and meticulous formulation. HYSSES is about enjoying the purity and goodness of nature’s gifts from all over the world; She embodies an authentic sense of preserving nature, heritage and appreciation for the native communities that have helped shape and broaden her journey.

name: JD
description: JD is a global retailer of Sport Fashion branded and own brand casual wear, combining internationally recognised brands such as Nike, adidas, Puma and New Balance, with strong own brand labels such as Pink Soda and Supply & Demand.

name: Jean Yip Hair and Hair Spa
description: With over 30 years of rich and expansive experience in the art of beautifying customers, Jean Yip Group is Singapore’s leading hair and beauty chain. Jean Yip Salon has over 60 outlets island-wide with a strong and evolving team of over 800 creative hairstylists and professional beauty therapists. Jean Yip service ranges from hairdressing to beauty and slimming services to providing one-stop beauty services. Catering to the individual needs of everyone, Jean Yip aims to fulfill all your beauty wishes.

name: Jiak Ba Food Heaven 甲霸食堂
description: A casual Taiwanese eatery bringing the vibrant flavors of Taiwan straight to your table. Known for its authentic street snacks and hearty rice bentos, we serve up classics like crispy, golden-fried Night Market Chicken, comforting bowls of handmade oyster mee sua, and an extensive selection of delicious bento sets. Whether you’re craving a quick bite or a satisfying meal, our dishes deliver a true taste of Taiwan—affordable, delicious, and full of heartwarming flavors.

name: Jollibee
description: Jollibee, the largest fast food chain with more than 1200 stores worldwide has arrived at VivoCity. Satisfy your fast food cravings with a bucket of Crispylicious Chickenjoy, or signature Jolly Spaghetti with a Filipino twist.

name: Joyre TCMedi Clinic
description: Joyre TCMedi Clinic is a pioneer in integrating Traditional Chinese Medicine with modern spa treatments and beauty aesthetics services to deliver personalised treatments that match each individual’s body constitution, and lifestyle to bring about a sense of balance and total wellness.

name: JUNGSAEMMOOL
description: JUNGSAEMMOOL empowers your ‘Youtiful’ journey, celebrating beauty that is uniquely yours. Founded by Korea’s #1 makeup artist, we believe makeup should enhance—not hide—your natural features. Each product is crafted with decades of professional expertise, blending artistry and innovation for effortless, radiant looks. From skin-perfecting bases to colors that bring out your personal beauty, our creations reveal your most confident self. With JUNGSAEMMOOL, beauty is a personal expression—timeless, refined, and truly you. Discover the art of enhancing your own beauty, beautifully.

name: Kaleido
description: At Kaleido, life’s too short for boring jewellery. It should always be stylish, affordable and crafted with care. Our collections are designed to bring trend-driven flair and everyday magic to your look, all at ready-to-wear prices. Discover timeless staples you’ll wear on repeat and trend-led pieces that let you switch up your vibe whenever the mood strikes. Affordable? Absolutely. Stylish? Always. This is jewellery that celebrates every facet of you

name: kate spade NEW YORK
description: Crisp color, graphic prints and playful sophistication are the hallmarks of Kate Spade New York. From handbags and clothing to jewelry, fashion accessories, eyewear, shoes and gifts, their exuberant approach to the everyday encourages personal style with a dash of incandescent charm. Kate Spade New York calls it living colorfully. They have over 300 retail shops internationally, and their colorful products are sold in more than 450 doors worldwide, in every time zone and on every continent. Whether in San Francisco, Sao Paulo or Shanghai, their shops are always warm and inviting.

name: Kazo
description: Driven to delight customers with a unique balance of flavoursome desserts, KAZO® (卡滋屋) serves a decadent range of Taiwanese pastries and desserts baked fresh with the finest ingredients specially flown from Taiwan to uphold its authentic Taiwanese taste.

name: Kei Kaisendon
description: Kei Kaisendon is a Japanese restaurant that serves delicious rice bowls topped with fresh sashimi from the seas of Japan! Every dish is specially designed with the right blend of fish, toppings, and seasonings to give you a unique taste every time. Come discover our Kaisendon for yourself!

name: Kenangan Coffee
description: Kenangan Coffee is the fastest growing grab-and-go coffee chain from Indonesia, founded in 2017. It has over 850 stores in Indonesia, Malaysia, and is now available in Singapore. Kenangan Coffee is known for its coffee beans of signature Arabica blend, the Archipelago Blend and signature Kenangan Latte. It also offers coffee, tea, and food.

name: KFC
description: Hand-breaded, freshly prepared and Finger Lickin’ Good! Our chicken isn’t made the fast way or the easy way. IT’S MADE THE HARD WAY. KFC landed in Singapore in 1977, when the first restaurant opened its doors at Somerset Road. Today KFC serves more than 1 million customers each month through over 80 stores across Singapore. This makes KFC one of the largest fast food chains in the country.

name: Kiehl’s
description: Kiehl’s began as a New York apothecary in 1851. For more than 160 years, they have served customers the finest formulations for skin and hair developed with the most advanced technologies and natural ingredients that are clinically proven to be safe, efficacious and gentle enough for even sensitive skin.

name: Kikanbo 鬼金棒 カラシビ味噌ら一麺
description: Kikanbo is a renowned ramen restaurant brand that originated in Tokyo, Japan in 2009. Famous for its signature spicy and numbing miso ramen, Kikanbo combines rich flavors with a powerful sensory experience that engages all five senses. Our Concept At Kikanbo, we specialize in “Kara-Shibi” ramen — a unique blend of “Kara” (spicy) from select red chili peppers and “Shibi” (numbing) from Japanese sansho and Sichuan peppercorns. Our goal is to deliver a bold, unforgettable ramen experience that stimulates not only your taste buds but your entire being

name: Kiwami Ramen & Teppan Bar
description: Kiwami Teppan, Ramen & Gyoza Bar debuts its first teppanyaki concept at VivoCity, bringing together Teppanyaki with Kiwami’s signature ramen and handcrafted gyozas. Known for its emphasis on quality and authentic flavours, Kiwami prepares its tonkotsu broth by simmering 100% Japanese pork bones for over 10 hours and pairs it with noodles made from premium Hokkaido wheat. Kiwami VivoCity menu features classic and premium ramen, freshly grilled teppanyaki, and fusion creations inspired by Singaporean favourites such as laksa, chilli crab, and satay. Guests can enjoy a modern Japanese dining experience that blends Japanese craftsmanship with Singapore’s iconic flavours.

name: Koi Thé
description: KOI Thé keeps Taiwan’s heritage of premium bubble tea alive with consistently controlled quality and standardized preparation processes. KOI vows not only to make tea-tasting a pleasant experience, but also to turn Taiwanese teas into a global heritage by introducing beverages to everyone.

name: Koong Woh Tong
description: Koong Woh Tong is an authentic herbal jelly and herbal tea house. Its herbal jelly is made with delicate ingredients and process using age-old secret recipe, it is highly recognized and delighted by royal family of ancient Chinese dynasty.

name: Kopitiam Food Hall
description: Beyond dining, Kopitiam Food Hall presents a multi-sensorial blend of cultural and artistic touches, creating a vibrant dining space for both locals and international visitors. Savour a plethora of flavours from Singapore and across Asia at 30 diverse food stalls including a bar with local inspired cocktails, celebrating the Tastes and Smells of culinary traditions and origins. Highlights include Singaporean street favourites such as Michelin-listed Ann Chin Handmade Popiah and Royal Rojak, alongside Chinese, Thai, Japanese, Korean, and Indonesian cuisines. Muslim diners can savour well-loved specialties from Hua Zai Ampang Yong Tau Foo and Hajah Maimunah Nasi Padang, alongside Chinese favourites like carrot cake, char kway teow, Monster Chilli Mala Hot Pot, Ying Jia Steam Fish, and more. A feast for the Sight once you step into a dining space transformed by vibrant, artfully designed murals, created in partnership with Singaporean contemporary urban artists, Ink and Clog Studio. Embark on a sensory-rich dining journey where textured ridge tiles, polished granite bar tops, and plush seating engage your sense of Touch, while vibrant beats from Flint Specialty Grill & Bar fill the space with Sound!

name: Krispy Kreme
description: Krispy Kreme is an international retailer of premium-quality sweet treats, including its signature Original Glazed® doughnut. Headquartered in Winston-Salem, N.C., the Company has offered the highest-quality doughnuts and great-tasting coffee since 1937. Today, Krispy Kreme can be found in over 1000 locations in over 24 countries around the world.

name: LA Barbershop / LA Cowboy Kids
description: LA Barbershop is a concept by the renowned Japanese Komars Group. It is one of the first few brands in town to offer a complete bespoke, exclusive grooming experience for men from shaving to haircut, massage to ear-cleaning services. Aiming to evoke a sense of nostalgia, this is the place where men can enjoy the pleasures of professional men grooming services.

name: LAC Nutrition for Life
description: LAC brand, short for Leader in Antioxidative Control™, a leading health and wellness supplement brand with a global presence. Since its founding, LAC has embarked on a pioneering journey to develop scientifically based formulas, harnessing the best of eastern wisdom and western technology to fight free radicals, combat ageing brought forth by oxidative stress, and support you daily in looking, feeling, and functioning at your best.

name: Lacoste
description: Since 1933, we aspire to inspire. Driven by the original Crocodile, our founder, René Lacoste. From the tennis courts to the streets, all the way to the runways, We hybridize styles. Create unconventional encounters. Iconic polos, original collaborations, new collections… Creativity is our obsession. More than a style, elegance becomes a way of life. We weave social and sustainable initiatives, one step at a time. And set our creations free to live to the beat of the city.

name: Le Shrimp Ramen
description: Inspired by the flavours of Japanese ramen broth and silky threads of Chinese la mian, Le Shrimp Ramen is a perfect marriage of Chinese and Japanese culture, offering a simple menu of elaborate flavours. Featuring two specialty broths – shrimp broth and tonkotsu broth, each has its own dedicated followers. The tonkotsu broth achieves a rich and creamy texture after long hours of simmering with pork bones, resulting in a collagen-rich and palatable soup. Prawn aficionados cannot resist our shrimp broth, featuring the flawless union of fresh sea prawns, pork bones and Chinese spices, giving the broth a delightful tangerine-orange hue.

name: L.E. Underground
description: Limited Edt is Singapore’s most famous source for sneakers from all the main sports and lifestyle brands like Nike, Adidas, Reebok, Puma, Vans, Converse, New Balance, Asics, Onitsuka Tiger amongst others. The L.E. Underground store stocks the biggest collection of sneakers in a single store anywhere in Singapore.

name: LEE HWA
description: Founded in 1970, Lee Hwa is one of Asia’s leading contemporary fine jewellers in Singapore, introducing diamond and gold statement jewellery for everyday and occasion wear. An expert on diamonds, Lee Hwa introduced Destinée, The Perfect Diamond, to the APAC region. The brand also welcomed ITALGOLD, artisanal 916 Gold perfected by fine Italian craftsmanship, to its oeuvre of gold jewellery which includes the world’s first 19k solid Purple Gold. Lee Hwa is also the exclusive distributor of world-renowned brands such as De Beers Forevermark, Niessing, Fabergé and Stenzhorn.

name: lenskart
description: Lenskart is a leading global omnichannel eyewear brand that provides quality and stylish eyeglasses, sunglasses and contact lenses at affordable prices. It achieves this by designing, producing and delivering its own eyewear, eliminating seven layers of middlemen. Powered by technology, Lenskart brings glasses that are 100% robo-made, lenses accurate up to three decimal places, innovative features such as 3D try-on, and more. Lenskart offers complimentary eye tests at all its stores.

name: LeNu Chef Wai’s Noodle Bar
description: Affordable yet remarkable, LeNu is a casual Chinese noodle bar that strives to achieve perfection in every bowl to delight all diners at an affordable price. Pair their braised beef broth or signature pork bone soup with your preferred noodles option and different meat selections, for a perfectly customised bowl of Chinese noodles.

name: Levi’s
description: The Levi’s® brand epitomizes classic American style and effortless cool. Since their invention by Levi Strauss & Co. in 1873, Levi’s® jeans have become one of the most recognizable garments of clothing in the world – capturing the imagination and loyalty of people for generations. Today, the Levi’s® brand portfolio continues to evolve through a relentless pioneering and innovative spirit that is unparalleled in the apparel industry. Their range of leading jeanswear and accessories are available in more than 110 countries, allowing individuals around the world to express their personal style.

name: library@harbourfront
description: Set against a splendid view of Sentosa, library@harbourfront is a new reading and learning destination for patrons across Singapore with a collection of 200,000 volumes. It is designed with two distinct zones – one for adults and teens, and another for children – to provide conducive spaces and enhanced services that suit their reading and learning needs. The Children’s Zone enables young readers to learn through technology, with the first-ever makerspace for children aged three to nine, as well as Augmented Reality books that bring stories to life. The Adults’ and Teens’ Zone is volunteer-run, and offers flexible spaces to host programmes that support digital readiness and lifelong learning.

name: LiHO TEA
