description: LiHO TEA 里喝 means, “how are you?” in the Chinese dialect – Hokkien and what LiHO want to show is that despite the differences in language and culture among different races in Singapore, a simple greeting of LiHO! can bond us together and that is what LiHO signify – a proud Singapore tea beverage brand that every Singaporean can relate to. A good cup of tea can leave people reminiscing about the taste. At LiHO, they believe that a good cup of tea topped off with cheese will leave you surprised, delighted and wanting more. Hence, LiHO is founded by a belief that delicious cheese tea & beverages should be available to everyone conveniently anywhere, anytime.

name: llaollao
description: Born in 2009 in Spain, llaollao ™ is currently a company with an international presence. It has more than 400 yogurt shops located in five continents and ranks as the leader in the frozen yogurt sector. llaollao is proud to serve customers the freshest and most delicious frozen yogurt, using the finest ingredients to maintain both the authenticity and health benefits of yogurt.

name: L'OCCITANE
description: Visiting a L’Occitane boutique means finding a little corner of Provence, taking in its sensations and warmth, and a discovery of rich experience for the senses. L’Occitane offers a Provencal lifestyle of natural beauty, colors, scents and traditions. Using only 100% natural essential oils and ingredients with respect to man and the environment, the highest quality skincare, body care and fragrances are created.

name: LOJEL
description: At LOJEL, we create carry essentials to simplify movement, freeing you to focus on what matters. Our products empower life’s journeys, encourage mindful movement, and promote sustainable lifestyles.

name: Love, Bonito
description: At Love, Bonito, we make infinitely wearable clothes; timelessly feminine pieces that let you be you, ever-ready for your calendar, and all the in-betweens. Designed for all the real, everyday stuff that no one else gets. Clothes designed to give you a breather – because the rest of your life rarely does.

name: LOVE & CO.
description: Love & Co. celebrates the proclamation of romance with an exceptional range of couple bands and engagement rings. The bespoke designs are infused with the finest craftsmanship and creativity that will certainly find favour amongst the discerning couples who are in search of the promise of eternal love. Love & Co. also celebrates individual stories through customisation that extends into gifting jewellery – a fun and attainable segment for you to express your personality. Love & Co redefines traditions to offer jewellery that can be made truly yours in many ways, as well as, diamonds crafted for our increasingly conscious world.

name: LOVET
description: Lovet, founded and designed in Singapore, creates thoughtfully crafted apparel that blends quality, comfort, and timeless style. From minimalist staples to refined elegance, we perfect the fit for the everyday woman, empowering her to express her story through every stage of life.

name: luckin coffee
description: luckin coffee was founded in 2017, headquartered is based in Xiamen, China. luckin coffee is a new leading retail coffee company. Pioneering new technology-driven retail model, luckin coffee aims to provide high quality coffee and products with great affordability, and convenience to our customers. Our coffee beans come directly from top coffee producing regions, and we have won the gold medal of IIAC for five consecutive years. Every batch of out coffee is carefully blended by our team of the WBC champions.

name: lululemon
description: lululemon offers athletic apparel for yoga, running, training, and most other sweaty pursuits. Creating transformational products and experiences to elevate the world by unleashing the full potential in everyone.

name: LUSH
description: Since establishing in 1995, Lush has been driven by innovation and its ethics. Lush are creators of pioneering beauty products such as the fizzing bath bomb, shower jellies and solid shampoo bars, placing emphasis on fresh ingredients like organic fruits and vegetables.

name: Maison Margiela
description: In 1994, Maison Margiela created ‘Replica’, a collection of clothing and accessories inspired by garments collected from around the world and chosen for the universality and timelessness of their style and history. Each garment is reproduced identically and is marked with a plain white label indicating its provenance, period, and style description.

name: Mamma Mia! Trattoria E Caffe
description: Mamma Mia! Trattoria E Caffe is a casual-style dining restaurant that serves true and simple Italian fare in an unpretentious and inviting Trattoria atmosphere. Artisan pastas that are handcrafted with fresh ingredients and cooked à la minute take centrestage. From antipasti, handcrafted pasta, rice and other mealtime delectables to mouth-watering desserts, the Italian nosh at Mamma Mia! Trattoria E Caffe is sure to satisfy all palates.

name: Mango
description: Mango was founded in 1984 and is today one of the leading fashion groups in the world. Based in its city of origin, Barcelona, the company has an extensive store network of 803,000 m2 in 110 countries. From its “El Hangar” Design Centre in Palau-solità i Plegamans, every year it designs more than 18,000 garments and accessories for wearing the season’s trends.

name: Marché Food Lovers' Place
description: Embark on a culinary journey through the flavours of Europe amidst the charming ambiance of a traditional Swiss village. Marché restaurant boasts authentic 500-year-old Swiss mountain houses and a cable car imported directly from Switzerland, offering an immersive dining experience like no other. Savour a delightful array of European delicacies including classic Swiss Rösti, Spanish Paella, German Pork Knuckle and more. Our menu also features quality meats grilled over applewood and market-fresh seafood, ensuring every bite is a taste sensation. Witness the artistry of our chefs as they prepare your meal before your eyes and quench your thirst with our selection of freshly squeezed homemade lemonades, iced teas and more. Join us for an unforgettable dining experience now.

name: Marks & Spencer
description: Well known and loved by millions of people across the world, Marks and Spencer offers high quality fashion, award-winning food and stylish homeware. Founded more than a century ago and with 1,000+ stores across 45+ countries, today Marks and Spencer is one of the UK’s leading retailers. They understand the importance of Quality, Value, Service, Innovation and Trust and live by these values in everything that they do. Through constant innovation, they make their own products and tailor the shopping experience to delight customers around the world.

name: Massimo Dutti
description: Massimo Dutti was incorporated to the Group in 1991 and it epitomises elegant and universal style that connects with the independent, cosmopolitan men and women of today. Its collections span from the most sophisticated of looks to more casual styles. Massimo Dutti always ensures it uses high quality fabrics that are also practical and comfortable. Massimo Dutti is present in 74 markets and has a network of 765 stores, which are found only in the best shopping locations and are designed with the customer’s ease and comfort in mind.

name: McDonald's
description: Enjoy the familiar taste of your McDonald’s® favourites right here. Pick up a sumptuous Egg McMuffin® and a freshly brewed McCafe® premium roast coffee for breakfast. Tuck into a McSpicy® meal for a hearty lunch or a McWrap® for dinner. Whichever way, McDonald’s promise better value all day.

name: McHugs
description: Founded in the UK, McHugs brings together “Mc,” a tribute to Scottish heritage, and “Hugs,” a symbol of warmth and emotional connection. We specialize in companionship-focused plush toys crafted from premium, skin-soft materials to deliver comfort, security, and joy. Our VivoCity store offers an immersive and interactive retail experience, where modern minimalism meets refined British charm. Every McHugs creation is rigorously safety-certified, reflecting our commitment to quality, care, and lasting reassurance. Step into the world of “Always Warm Hugs” and discover the perfect therapeutic companion for every age.

name: Meow BBQ 猫抓烤肉
description: Ever since its opening in 2012, Meow Barbecue has quickly grown to become one of the most popular grill restaurant chains, with locations all over major cities in China, such as Beijing, Chengdu, Chongqing etc. Known and loved for its high-quality ingredients and adorable mascot, Meow Barbecue landed its pick for their first international location on the vibrant city of Singapore. Combining Japanese-style meat selection, Korean-style marinade, and Chinese-style cooking, Meow Barbecue is a fusion of the best tongue-tickling, delectable flavors.

name: M.G.M Foreign Exchange
description: Money exchange for all foreign currencies.

name: Michael Kors
description: Unmistakably American style, impeccable tailoring and attention to detail are the key features of the Kors brand. Alongside the understated handbags, clothes stand out with striking prints and colours, watches, eye-catching designer sunglasses and sportswear inspired shoes.

name: Mincheng Bibimbap 민정비빔밥 敏丁拌饭
description: Mincheng Bibimbap 민정비빔밥 敏丁拌饭 is a renowned establishment specializing in Chinese Korean (中国朝鲜族) ethnic cuisine, offering a unique blend of flavors that reflect the rich culinary heritage of the Yanbian Korean Autonomous Prefecture in China. Since its inception in 2008, Mincheng has expanded globally with over 400 outlets worldwide. Our menu boasts a diverse range of dishes, with the iconic Mincheng Bibimbap taking center stage. In addition to this signature dish, we offer Stone Plate series and a selection of savory soups inspired by Korean traditions. Complementing these are complimentary offerings like Rice Kimchi and seaweed soup, ensuring a complete and satisfying dining experience. Exploring the flavours of Chinese Korean ethnic today

name: MINISO
description: MINISO Singapore is a lifestyle and design-driven retail brand committed to delivering high-quality products at accessible prices. Inspired by simplicity, creativity, and global trends, MINISO offers a diverse range of goods, from plush toys and accessories to homeware, beauty essentials, and seasonal collections. With a focus on thoughtful design and joyful shopping experiences, MINISO collaborates with popular IPs and international designers to bring fresh and trendy products to customers. Since entering the Singapore market, the brand has continued to grow its presence, providing shoppers with a fun, affordable, and uplifting retail experience.

name: Mister Donut
description: Makers of the legendary Pon De Ring donuts. Enjoy high-quality donuts made with ingredients from Japan and prepared by staff with careful training at the Mister Donut academy in Osaka.

name: Mister Minit
description: Mister Minit specializes in repair services, key fitting and duplication. Engraving services, leather care and shop repair services are also available.

name: MLB
description: MLB is a premium lifestyle brand from South Korea, offering a comprehensive collection of apparel and accessories inspired by sports and culture. Reborn as a Korean fashion brand in 1997, MLB is pioneering consumer lifestyles and leading trends by incorporating oriental messages in USA sports DNA in a modern way. Globally recognised as the go-to destination for streetwear, MLB presents a wide range of effortlessly cool caps and apparel, stylishly emblazoned with logos of iconic baseball teams. Step into the world of MLB to elevate your K-style game and bring fun to your everyday wardrobe with iconic streetwear for all.

name: Mobilestop
description: At Mobilestop, our journey began with a simple yet powerful vision: to transform the way people experience and protect their mobile devices. Established by a team of tech enthusiasts, we understand that your mobile device isn’t just a tool—it’s an extension of your personality and lifestyle. We curate a diverse selection of accessories that not only safeguard your device but also elevate its aesthetic appeal. We are committed to exceptional customer service and in building lasting relationships with our customers, which is why every interaction with Mobilestop is characterised by personalised attention and genuine care.

name: MONDAYS MADE
description: Mondays Made is a demi-fine jewelry brand that inspires self-expression through refined pieces that carry a touch of whimsy. Crafted in 18k gold and rhodium vermeil, natural gemstones and moissanites, each collection is thoughtfully designed to reflect your personal narrative, your mood, or your spirit. Look good and do good —10% of our profits are donated to charities that support the communities around us.

name: Monster Curry
description: Monster Curry is big on taste as it is in size. Recognized for its deep, dark and rich brown sauce which comes from cooking roasted caramel for up to 5 hours, the gourmet curry is paired with succulent cuts of toppings available in 3 options – Original, Seafood and Meat. Signature dishes include the Monster Curry Combo dishes that serve up to two, and they include the Mountain Monster Curry, Flame Monster Curry and Monster Combo Curry. The Cheese Pork Katsu, the Natto and Egg Curry and Pork Shabu-Shabu Omelette are must-try dishes too.

name: MONTIGO
description: At Montigo, hydration always comes first with passion a close second. We create drinkware that fuels every passion you have in life, whether a hobby, your career, or keeping up with the people you love. For all the good or bad times, the smiles and the laughs, we want to be there, every step of the way. Montigo is committed to being the simple reminder everyone needs to slow down, take a sip, and continue pursuing what matters most. From the first sip to the last drop, we aim to be there with you.

name: 雙月 Moon Moon Food
description: Moon Moon Food is renowned for its flagship store on Qingdao East Road, which has earned the Michelin Bib Gourmand accolade every year since 2018. The restaurant has earned a stellar reputation for authentically capturing the essence of Taiwanese flavours. Each dish at Moon Moon Food is crafted with care, warmth and a focus on quality and simplicity, aiming to evoke the “culture of home” through Taiwan’s local culinary traditions.

name: motherlove
description: With over 20 years of industry experience, Motherlove is Singapore’s Leading Prenatal and Postnatal Healthcare Expert. We offer 37 treatment programmes backed by science, tailored for every stage of pregnancy, postpartum recovery, and menopause. Our holistic approach combines cutting-edge technology and specialised hand techniques to deliver clinically proven results. At Motherlove, our mission is simple yet profound: to empower mothers and women to prioritise their health and reclaim their confidence.

name: Mr. Coconut
description: Mr. Coconut is a Singapore’s brand which is well-known for its coconut-based beverages. Started in 2016, Mr. Coconut aims to share the natural goodness and nutritional benefits of coconuts with everyone. Our products are made with 100% Fresh Coconut Juice, prepared daily, well suited for the humid weather. It also provides coconut lovers with a satisfying and refreshing feel.

name: Mr Hainan 海南先生 - Hainan Cuisine
description: At Mr Hainan, we showcase the soul of Hainan cuisine—light, authentic, and deep rooted in heritage. From our signature Wenchang chicken to fresh baby threadfin, every dish highlights the essence of fresh ingredients. Influenced by the richness of Central China, the finesse of Fujian and Guangdong, the charm of Southeast Asia, and the traditions of the Li and Miao people, Hainan’s flavors are a tapestry of cultures. Simple yet profound, our food carries the island’s stories, offering a dining experience that is both timeless and uniquely Hainan.

name: Mr.Onigiri
description: Founded by Marvin and Joyce, Mr Onigiri originated from their trip to Okinawa, Japan. Enchanted by the humble yet delicious Onigiri, they were inspired to introduce this authentic experience to Singapore. Starting as a home-based weekend business, Mr Onigiri quickly gained popularity, leading to the opening of their first store in September 2022. Each Onigiri is lovingly made and carries the warm spirit of Okinawa. Join Mr. Onigiri on a culinary journey that weaves Okinawa’s flavours into Singapore’s culinary landscape, where food becomes a conduit for stories, memories, and friendships. Experience the extraordinary gastronomical delight of Onigiri!

name: MUJI
description: MUJI, originally founded in Japan in 1980, offers a wide variety of good quality products including household goods, apparel and food.

name: N20 Nail Spa
description: N20 Nail Spa offers full-fledged professional nail services, projecting a colourful and lifestyle image for each individual. Their priorities are your beauty and well-being. N20 Nail Spa offers a wide selection of vegan/organic polish and products as a display of their commitment to promote healthy and eco living.

name: Nailz Gallery
description: Nailz Gallery is one of Singapore’s leading beauty and health retailers specialise as a one-stop premier center Nail Spa located in different areas of Singapore, which offers a variety of state-of-the-art manicure, pedicure, and eyelash extension, eyebrow embroidery, and spa treatment since 2013.

name: Nailz Treats
description: Nailz Treats is a one-stop full-fledged Nails, Lash and Brows grooming salon providing you a non-toxic beauty experience with a strong emphasis on clean environment and clean beauty for our community by carefully selecting and using only non-toxic, vegan gel and lacquer and offering products and services that are paraben-free and cruelty-free. Beauty services include: Manicure, Pedicure, Eyelash Extensions, Eyebrow Embroidery, Waxing, Makeup Services.

name: 南记 Nam Kee Pau
description: Nam Kee Pau specializes in traditional handmade pau from the authentic traditional recipe of the famous Nam Kee Pau in Johor Bahru in Malaysia. At Nam Kee Pau, all the pau items are handmade in house. You will definitely enjoy a “filling meal” at a reasonable price.

name: Naomi
description: Naomi is an aspiring brand that aims to provide luxurious fashion style for our growing girls. A Japan inspired brand idea that imagines the future of clothing and fashion lifestyle for kids. Naomi focuses on high quality and long-lasting garments, continuously bringing inspirations into life for the kids to unleash their inner model every day. We encourage the journey of parenthood with us as we showcase a never dull look into the mini fashion world.

name: Nasty Cookie
description: Sinfully created from a humble home baking business in 2018, Nasty Cookie is Singapore’s first New-York inspired gourmet cookie brand with fillings . Specially handcrafted and baked with utmost tender, loving care to provide a crispy, chunky and chewy texture altogether.

name: Natureland Spa. Therapy
description: Natureland is a leading wellness brand dedicated to providing high-quality massage experiences. Experience the perfect indulgence at Natureland. An essential escape from the demands of urban life, our thoughtfully curated therapeutic body and foot massages are designed to restore balance to your mind, body, and soul. Natureland offers a serene, luxurious retreat where you can unwind, recharge, and embrace true rejuvenation.

name: Nespresso
description: Immerse yourself in a multi-sensory coffee experience at the all-new boutique concept, which allows for deep learning and coffee exploration. Experience the elements that reflect Nespresso’s deep commitment to sustainability and adherence to a circular economy.

name: New Balance
description: Independent since 1906, we empower people through sport and craftsmanship to create positive change in communities around the world. Known for our unwavering commitment to quality, innovation and performance, we blend heritage with modern design to support every athlete – from elites to passionate everyday movers. Whether you’re chasing a new personal best or walking through the city, New Balance goes the distance with you.

name: WESTON CORP
description: Weston is Singapore’s Premier Soccer Store with the largest collection of Soccer Boots & Jerseys.

name: NEW ERA
description: After decades as the official on-field cap of MLB, New Era is now the go-to brand for exclusive sports headwear. With classic cap styles, superb quality and embroidered team logos across 3 major U.S leagues, this is the ultimate symbol of a true fan. New Era headwear also has its own following in the urban streetwear scene for their versatility and style. If you want in on this, head over to New Era today!

name: 农耕记 Nong Geng Ji
description: Known as the leading brand of Hunan Cuisine in China, Nong Geng Ji has over 100 stores worldwide and is bringing its authentic and delicious Hunan dishes to Singapore. Employing traditional Hunan-style cooking techniques and the selection of only fresh native Hunan ingredients, Nong Geng Ji is ready to impress local diners with its Top Three signature dishes including Stir-Fried Pork with Abalone and Chili, Signature Grass Fish Fillet with Chili, and Stir-Fried Beef with Dried Chili.

name: Oakley
description: Established in 1975 and acquired in 2007, Oakley is one of the leading product design and sport performance brands in the world, chosen by world-class athletes to compete at the highest level possible. The holder of more than 850 patents, Oakley is also known for its innovative lens technologies, including PRIZMTM. Oakley extended its position as a sports eyewear brand into apparel and accessories, offering men’s and women’s product lines that appeal to sport performance, active and lifestyle consumers.

name: OGAWA
description: OGAWA is a leading brand in intelligent wellness technology, dedicated to improving everyday life through innovation and thoughtful design. With nearly 30 years of research and development and over 2,000 international patents, OGAWA creates innovative massage and wellness solutions that promote relaxation, recovery, and holistic well-being. Each product is carefully crafted to complement modern lifestyles, offering smart features, ergonomic comfort, and refined aesthetics. Trusted in more than 80 countries, OGAWA continues to shape the future of home wellness with intelligent care and lasting comfort — for everybody, for everybody.

name: Oh! Sunny
description: All things sun-safe and stylish… Oh Sunny is Singapore’s one-stop shop for sun-protective clothings and accessories for the family. Since 2011, Oh Sunny takes pride on proprietary industry-leading fabric technology to provide ultimate UV protection for daily adventures. Our Twilight fabric is UPF50+ rated, the highest standard in the industry, effectively blocking 99% of harmful UV rays. Oh Sunny is passionate about fusing fashion with technology and performance. Our products are trendy and comfortable, meant to be mixed, matched and layered, for your family’s everyday styles.

name: Old Chang Kee
description: Established in 1956, Old Chang Kee is Singapore’s homegrown snack, food and beverage chain. With the goal to deliver superior quality and value to its customers, the company is a household name, known for its signature curry puffs and a wide variety of high-quality hot finger food and ready meals. From one coffeeshop stall, Old Chang Kee now has over 100 outlets across Singapore, and overseas outlets in Australia, Indonesia, Malaysia and the United Kingdom.

name: Onitsuka Tiger
description: Japanese fashion brand Onitsuka Tiger presents a contemporary collection that combines fashion with sports, and heritage with innovation. With designs ranging from updated classic silhouettes to refreshing new styles and collaborations with like-minded artists and cultural connoisseurs, the spirit of Japan resonates in each new collection of Onitsuka Tiger shoes, apparel and accessories.

name: OSIM
description: OSIM is about the experience of total well-being and living an inspiring life. We channel our Brand at every customer touch point, communicating our values through our products, our outlet, our brand image, our service excellence and in-depth knowledge of holistic health. With over 40 years of experience and uncompromising dedication in developing innovative and reliable healthy lifestyle products. OSIM is the name you can trust for a healthier lifestyle and overall well-being.

name: OWNDAYS
description: Leading Japanese eyewear brand OWNDAYS is committed to offering high-quality, fashionable eyewear at affordable prices. With a vast selection of over 1,500 stylish options starting from $98, our glasses can be ready for you in just 20 minutes upon payment.

name: PANDA CHAN SNACK
description: #Healthysnack #Fresh Chinese Pastries #Premium Roasted Chestnuts #Baked Sweet Potatoes #Artisanal Roasted Nuts #Freshly Made Asian Treats #Wholesome Baked Snacks #Natural Ingredients Snacks #Organic Chestnuts #Guilt-Free Indulgence

name: Pandora
description: Pandora designs, manufactures and markets hand-finished and contemporary jewellery made from high-quality materials at affordable prices. Pandora jewellery is sold in more than 100 countries on six continents through around 7,800 points of sale, including more than 2,400 concept stores.

name: PappaRich
description: PappaRich has around 100 outlets worldwide including Malaysia, Australia, China, Indonesia and now we have come to Singapore to give you a better choice of Malaysian Delights! At PappaRich you will be able to find authentic and delicious staple Malaysian cuisine in the urban city of Singapore. While away from home, you can be sure to find the ease and comfort food at PappaRich to satisfy your hunger!

name: Paradise Dynasty
description: World’s first 8 flavoured xiao long bao Paradise Dynasty promises you a gastronomic journey through dynasties of China, with northern and southern Chinese cuisine across generations. Contemporary dining experience Indulge in modern opulence in Paradise Dynasty, with hanging lights and gold decorative elements. Be awed by the refreshing take with splashes of colours against the neutral dining environment. Immerse in the imperial culture Touted as a world-first, our xiao long bao comes in never-before, innovative flavours like crab roe, cheese, garlic, Korean kimchi, Szechuan and the kings among kings – foie gras and black truffle. Paradise Dynasty is set to delight diners with northern and southern China cuisine, with a touch of innovation.

name: Paradise Hotpot
description: A modern and trendy individual hotpot concept, Paradise Hotpot offers all-you-can-eat options that provides the best quality at affordable prices.

name: Parfums Christian Dior
description: When Christian Dior created his fashion house in 1946, he wanted women to rediscover joy, elegance and beauty. Today, his namesake label is synonymous with French luxury, appearing on haute couture, makeup, skincare and fragrances.

name: Paris Baguette
description: Paris Baguette, born in 1988, is a global bakery brand of SPC Group, a leading South Korean food and confectionery corporation. From its modest beginnings, the chain has grown steadily to become the No.1 bakery in Korea. From 2004, the brand has expanded internationally, the brand operates around 4,000 stores worldwide across the United States, Canada, France, UK, China and Southeast Asia, solidifying its reputation as a truly global premium bakery brand. Paris Baguette is committed to blending traditional baking techniques with modern innovation to deliver diverse range of products such as breads, pastries, cakes, and beverages that appeal to a wide audience, from everyday treats to special celebration.

name: Paris Miki
description: Established in Singapore since 1974, Paris Miki embodies the definition of an international eyewear retailer. Through their optical expertise coupled with a strong customer centric ethos, Paris Miki offers the best eye care services in Asia. Japanese hospitality, quality & aesthetics combine with international best practices to provide a unique and fulfilling customer experience.

name: Pastago and CHICHA San Chen
description: Pastago We are a quick service kiosk serving Fresh Pasta, Made-To-Order! It all started in 2022, with just a small pasta machine, a tiny space & the goal of making tasty Fresh Pasta accessible to everyone. ​ Through much trial & error, we are proud to serve our very own springy Pasta made from scratch, using Italian semolina flour. Paired with a variety of classic sauces & unique flavours, ​ each bite will leave you wanting more. CHICHA San Chen Originating from Taiwan, CHICHA San Chen (吃茶三千) was founded in 1998 with a mission to make high-quality, freshly brewed teas accessible to discerning tea drinkers. Built on a sense of mindfulness with every sip, CHICHA San Chen (吃茶三千) is handcrafted by Taiwanese tea masters with over 20 years of experience, including having its own tea mountain, professional tea tasters and tea roasters. CHICHA San Chen’s (吃茶三千) Green Tea hold a prestigious Highest International Authority ITI certification for quality and utilises an exclusive patented product and technology that allows more than 1,000 custom settings and three-stage temperature control brewing technique to bring out the tea’s best flavour and natural scent, and maintain consistency in the quality and taste profiles of their bubble tea. With high-quality tea as its mainstay, CHICHA San Chen (吃茶三千) marries the best of bubble tea with traditional tea bringing one of life’s greatest pleasures to the world.

name: Pazzion
description: PAZZION’s shoes capture the essence of today’s millennial woman: innate confidence, dynamic and a force to be reckoned with. Using only high-quality calf leather and lambskin to deliver optimal designs, PAZZION ensures affordable and effortlessly stylish shoes for all occasions, backed by exceptional craftsmanship; perfect for the modern women.

name: PEDRO
description: Experience the new store concept at PEDRO store and discover the full range of modern and contemporary selection from the latest themes of the season.

name: PLAYe
description: Funz Centre specializes in retailing trading card games, video games, Japanese collectibles and the latest toys.

name: PlayMade
description: PlayMade has captivated the hearts of tea enthusiasts with our commitment to using only the freshest ingredients. Our handcrafted bubble tea has become a beloved destination for those seeking imaginative and flavourful tea creations. Without the use of additives or preservatives, our bobas exemplify freshness. The result? Bobas that are not only delicious but also healthier, offering a delightful bounce and exceptional flavour.

name: Polar Puffs & Cakes
description: Serving up delectable puff pastries like Curry Puffs and Chicken Pies since 1926, Polar Puffs & Cakes has since come up with more options that reflect Singapore’s unique culture and palate. Besides baking our pastries fresh daily, our numerous outlets also serve our signature handmade Sugar Rolls, a delightful selection of cakes, and a wide range of adorable character cakes.

name: Polo Ralph Lauren
description: Ralph Lauren Corporation is a global leader in the design, marketing, and distribution of premium lifestyle products, including apparel, accessories, home furnishings, and other licenced product categories. For five decades, our long-standing reputation and distinctive image have been consistently developed across an expanding number of products, brands, sales channels, and international markets. We believe that our global reach, breadth of product offerings, and multichannel distribution are unique among luxury and apparel companies.

name: POPULAR
description: POPULAR is a one-stop retail hub experience that provides a comprehensive range of books, educational peripherals, stationery, household appliances, entertainment, lifestyle products, gadgets and IT products, titbits and more. With 30 stores islandwide and growing, it offers utmost convenience to families, students, and working adults.

name: Potato Corner
description: POTATO CORNER has been serving the world’s best flavored fries for 26 years. These fries are prepared fresh, fried to order, seasoned with passionately formulated flavors, and served hot and crispy. Potato Corner’s flavors are Cheese, Barbecue, Sour Cream, Onion, Chili Barbecue and a whole lot more! Today, it shakes irresistible flavored fries in Philippines, Indonesia, USA, Australia, Thailand, Panama, Hong Kong, Cambodia, Kuwait, Vietnam, and Singapore.

name: Poulét
description: Poulet is a modern French-themed bistro offering affordable French classics to the mass public since 2012. The French Roast Chicken maestro serves freshly roasted chicken that are brined overnight using an in-house secret recipe. The Poulet Roti is complemented with 4 signature sauces, they create a perfect symphony for the signature dish. Poulet presents itself as the perfect place for any occasion worth celebrating, with something for everyone to savour and indulge in.

name: Prada
description: Since 1913, Prada has been synonymous with cutting-edge style. Its fashion transcends products, translating conceptuality into a universe that has become a benchmark to those who dare to challenge conventions, focusing on experimentation. A brand of perpetual exploration and reinvention, Prada Beauty challenges perspectives and the status quo to serve as a precursor and pioneer, with a perspective of uncompromised quality, radical elegance, intellectual purity and freedom of creative experimentation.

name: Pramwash
description: Pramwash is Singapore’s first baby gear cleaning specialist. They have delivered 10,000+ super clean strollers and car seats that smell fresher than new to more than 6000 children till date. Pramwash is here to amplify the unspoken voice of a young child who can’t voice out their frustration and disgust of sitting in dirty stroller and car seat. Being featured in multiple media, encouraging parents to have a sustainable baby gear usage is part of their priorities, done through car seat recycling and pram redistribution to needy families.

name: prettyFIT
description: Founded in 1994, prettyFIT is a fashion-forward brand that embodies a confident and unconstrained woman who seeks to express her own unique individuality. Driven by its aspirations to set women free from boundaries, prettyFIT re-defines comfort by incorporating numerous comfort-centered technologies to make our shoes so much softer, more enjoyable and wearable. The brand’s intricate, trend-focused products have become sartorial essentials for women from all walks of life. To date, prettyFIT has spanned across 5 countries with 34 stores, with presence in leading retail malls in Bulgaria, Indonesia, Myanmar, Singapore and Thailand.

name: Prime Auto Care
unit: #Lot 800 on B1 Carpark/ Lot 226 on B2 Carpark
description: Grooming is essential and there is no one better than Pime Auto Care to help you groom and pamper your car.

name: PRISM+
description: PRISM+ is Singapore’s fastest-growing consumer electronics brand. Known as the country’s #1 TV and Monitor brand, it has recently become the first local brand to launch its own Smart Air Conditioner System, Smart Ceiling Fan, Smart Air Purifiers, and Refrigerators. With a reputation for delivering wallet-friendly products that are packed with features and backed by award-winning customer service, PRISM+ continues to define the future of smart home technology.

name: Project Acai
description: Established in 2015, Project Acai is Singapore’s first dedicated Acai cafes. At Project Acai, freshly made Acai bowls, smoothies, and vegan snacks are served daily. The Acai base is always small batch and freshly blended throughout the day. Project Acai is on a mission to show Singapore that eating healthy and making healthier choices is not difficult. Acai can be enjoyed as an easy, energising and nutritious option as either a meal, dessert, or snack without having to worry about unnecessary calories.

name: PUMA
description: PUMA is one of the world’s leading sports brands – designing, developing, selling and marketing footwear, apparel and accessories. For over 65 years, PUMA has established a history of making fast product designs for the fastest athletes on the planet. PUMA offers performance and sport-inspired lifestyle products in categories such as Football, Running, Training and Fitness, Golf, and Motorsports. It engages in exciting collaborations with renowned design brands such as Alexander McQueen and Mihara Yasuhiro to bring innovative and fast designs to the sports world.

name: PUTIEN
description: From a humble beginning to a popular chain, PUTIEN is now considered one of the leaders in Fujian cuisine in Singapore. PUTIEN focuses on bringing out the original taste in each of the ingredient used. One of the must-try specialties include the ‘Fried Heng Hwa Bee Hoon’ – made from old rice milled by hand in Putian. Infused with 10 sumptuous ingredients, this dish is one of the crowd’s favourite.

name: QB House
description: Time-Saving” Haircut Service QB House provides 10-minute quick cut service with a systematic queue system and individual haircutting stations. We considers “Time-Saving” from a haircut service at shortest possible time, to have the same social economic impact and benefits.

name: Rabeanco
description: Originally a Milano-based menswear leather accessories brand in the 1980s, RABEANCO started exporting to East Asia in the 90s. In the 2000s RABEANCO opened its first stores in Singapore and Hong Kong predominantly as a womens handbag brand. At RABEANCO we think of ourselves as scientists within the tradition of handbag making- relentless reimaginating of modern femininity and experimentation within this ancient craft as makers are at the heart of what we do. RABEANCO has 30 shops and over 40 points of distribution worldwide, with a predominantly East Asian fanbase.

name: Ray-Ban
description: Ray-Ban is considered to be one of the leading brands of sunglasses and prescription eyewear, best known for its line of Wayfarer and Aviator sunglasses. Founded by American company Bausch & Lomb in 1937, it introduced aviation sunglasses to pilots from the United States Army. By constantly experimenting with materials, designs and innovative technologies, Ray-Ban developed high-performing lenses such as its colour-enhancing Chromance lenses. Representing decades of authenticity and style, the iconic Ray-Ban sunglasses is arguably one of the best-selling type sunglasses worldwide. Browse the range of sunglasses by Ray-Ban in Singapore! Book your eye test via the link below!

name: RINA LEE
description: RINA LEE is a demi-fine jewellery brand that is heart-centered around healing and empowering women. By incorporating healing gemstones with mindful design, their pieces function as soul reminders and encouragements that stay with you through life’s ups and downs. RINA LEE soul’s mission is to spread self-love, strength & courage in all that they do.

name: Rising Money Exchange
description: Offer money changing services at a fair rate, along with a variety of snacks and drinks for purchase.

name: Rituals
description: They are everywhere: at any given moment, of every single day, waiting to be discovered, eager to share the beauty within them. They are the seemingly meaningless moments we all tend to overlook. Rituals unveils these moments and reminds you to experience them with joy. Whether it’s taking a nice long bath or creating a homey atmosphere with the rich scents of incense, Rituals allows you to find happiness in the smallest of things.

name: Riverside Canton Claypot Cuisine
description: Experience the rich, slow-cooked flavors of Riverside Canton Claypot Cuisine, where hearty claypot dishes take center stage. Savour signature Claypot Grilled Qing Jiang Fish in Green Pepper Sauce, Beef Brisket with Potato and Radish, or Tomato Salt Baked Chicken, each meticulously prepared to perfection. The menu also features many other flavourful claypots and a selection of other Cantonese dishes, perfect for enjoying hot, comforting meals.

name: Rollney
description: WORLD FAMOUS KURTOS ROLL ROLLNEY is a well-known dessert pastry brand with specializes in delivering a unique experience through the signature product—Kurtos Ice Cream, a delightful fusion of warm kurtos serve with irresistibly creamy soft-serve ice cream. Kurtos is made from sweet, raised yeast dough, spun into a strip, wrapped around a cone-shaped spit, and rolled in granulated sugara. The specialty of our product is the kurtos is handcrafted daily and served fresh from the oven. It’s crispy outside, fluffy inside. At Rollney, we empower customers to customize their own cups with high-quality toppings, including sauces, crunches and fruits. We are dedicated to ensuring customer satisfaction and happiness, spreading joy by serving only the best. Your satisfaction is our top priority.

name: Saboten
description: Established in 1966 and driven by a dedication to serve the best tonkatsu offerings, Saboten insistence to use only premium ingredient for their made-to-order Tonkatsu (Japanese Pork Cutlet).

name: SALOMON
description: Salomon is the modern mountain sports lifestyle brand creating innovative, premium and authentic footwear, apparel and winter sports equipment in the French Alps. At the Annecy Design Center, designers, engineers and athletes intersect to shape the future of sports and culture. At Salomon, we exist to unleash the best in people through mountain sports.

name: Samsonite
description: Samsonite is a retail concept offering business bags, backpacks, luggage and accessories across each distinguished brand under the umbrella of Samsonite – Samsonite, Samsonite Black Label, Samsonite RED, American Tourister and Hartmann.

name: Samsung
description: At Samsung Experience Stores, everything is easier. A place to explore our latest range, learn more about your device, get expert advice and receive technical support. Exclusive sneak peeks of our newest products and other great events are happening all the time. The possibilities are endless.

name: Sanook Kitchen
description: Come to Sanook Kitchen and savour a wide variety of authentic Thai food classics ranging from appetisers, soup, curries to seafood and more at wallet-friendly prices!

name: Sans & Sans
description: Emerging fashion brand, Sans & Sans, sets out to rejuvenate oriental fashion by incorporating sensuality and femininity exude elegance through contemporary east meets west aesthetics. ‘Twain shall meet’ the growing needs of modern women of today. For aspiring women to travel in style with the ease of movement in their fine fabric.

name: San.wich by Swee Heng
description: Specializing in sandwiches with a minimum 3 layers of delicious ingredients with wide variety of natural ingredients based bread which are baked from scratch every day to ensure the beauty of every bite lies in the perfect combination of flavours!

name: Seafood Paradise
description: From humble beginnings as a small hawker stall at Defu Lane, Seafood Paradise was the very first restaurant opened by Paradise Group and set the foundations for the restaurant group’s growth and expansion alongside with 12 other culinary restaurant concepts. “Where culinary of live seafood and local cuisine meets innovation” – Seafood Paradise is a showcase of seafood and Chinese cuisine with a strong Singaporean identity with a touch of innovation. Some of the must-order dishes and innovative creations truly unique to Seafood Paradise, includes the Signature Creamy Butter Crab topped with Coconut Crumbs, Popular Singapore Chilli Crab, Hot Plate Tofu with Preserved ‘Cai Xin’, Baked Pork Belly Ribs with Honey Pepper Sauce, and Deep-fried Cheese Bacon Roll. An array of H.K. style dim sum offerings will also be available during lunch.

name: Seiko
description: Since being established in 1881, Seiko has contributed to society with one revolutionary product after another – starting with the production of Japan’s first wristwatch in 1913 and including the creation of the world’s first quartz watch in 1969. Seiko has also been the official timekeeper at many international sporting events since the Tokyo Olympic Games in 1964. Seiko has been privileged to share moments of tremendous excitement with athletes and spectators worldwide.

name: Selffix DIY
description: Selffix DIY is a household name that customers have come to trust. In just over a decade, they have expanded into a fourteen-store chain, with staff that are trained to provide expert advice and solutions to help solve the most common household DIY needs.

name: sen-ryo
description: Originating from Tochigi in Kanto, Japan in 1999, sen-ryo will delight diners here in Singapore with Japanese creations that are authentic, exquisite and exceptional. These dishes are masterfully crafted by experienced ‘shokunin’ (artisanal) team whose attention to deal will make every dining experience an unforgettable one.

name: Seoul Noodle Shop
description: Seoul Noodle Shop, authentic Korean noodles made from scratch with chewy texture in rich master-crafted broth.

name: SEPHORA
description: Sephora, the world’s leading beauty retailer, revolutionized the beauty retailing concept by allowing customers to plunge into a sensual, exciting and entertaining world of cosmetics and perfume. With over 17,000 listed products and 1,700 stores across the world, it aims to provide a unique environment for experimentation and learning for beauty aficionados all around the world. Sephora is the heart of creativity and excellence, constantly innovating to provide its customers with game-changing products that are as accessible as they are exciting, as sensual as they are superior. A place to access your own unique beauty, Sephora is where beauty beats.

name: SEPHORA
description: Sephora is the world’s leading global prestige beauty retail brand. Sephora connects customers and beauty brands within the world’s most trusted and dynamic beauty community. We serve a highly engaged community of hundreds of millions of beauty followers across our global omnichannel network of stores and iconic flagships, and our e-commerce and digital platforms, offering personalized and immersive seamless experiences across every touchpoint.

name: Seremban Kee Mei Siew Pow
description: Heritage Siew Bao from Seremban with love to you, the original 48 years of traditional recipe and made in Singapore now.

name: SF Juice
description: Sink your teeth into these vitamin packed superfruits and juices here at SF Fruits. Offering you a wide variety of treats from the tropics, SF Fruits is on a mission to satisfy your taste buds with their carefully selected fruits and rejuvenating juices. Ranging from their creamy and palatable avocado smoothie to thirst-quenching signature H7 blend, their products are here to help you beat the heat!

name: Shabu Suki 99
description: At Shabu Suki 99, customers can enjoy a personalised hotpot experience with individual pots prepared for every diner. The menu offers a wide variety of beef and chicken selections, flavourful soup bases, fresh vegetables, sides, and beverages, giving customers the freedom to enjoy hotpot according to their own preferences. For a more convenient dining experience, Shabu Suki 99 also features specially curated set meals designed for easy ordering. Customers looking for greater flexibility can opt for the “Pair It” selections, where they can customise their preferred combination of meats, soup, vegetables, and sides to create their ideal hotpot meal.

name: Shake Shack
description: Shake Shack is a modern day “roadside” burger stand known for its 100% all-natural Angus beef burgers, chicken sandwiches and flat-top Vienna beef dogs (no hormones or antibiotics – ever), spun-fresh frozen custard, crinkle cut fries, craft beer and wine and more. With its fresh, simple, high-quality food at a great value, Shake Shack is a fun and lively community gathering place with widespread appeal. Shake Shack’s mission is to Stand for Something Good®, from its premium ingredients and caring hiring practices to its inspiring designs and deep community investment.

name: SK GOLD
description: Exude your inner radiance with SK Gold’s new 916 gold collection – SK 916 Gold. Designed for the edgy and free-spirited young millennials, SK 916 Gold accentuates the brand belief of “You Deserve to Shine” and it brings out the glow in every woman through confidence and style.

name: SK JEWELLERY
description: At SK Jewellery, they believe that everyone deserves to shine. They want to be there through all your significant moments as you cross new milestones, write new chapters and celebrate your life’s stories. They will always seek to delight through their passion for design, brilliant craftsmanship and deliver exceptional value with their diverse jewellery and special gift collections.

name: Skechers
description: Skechers is a footwear brand which is suitable for everyone. Its huge collection caters to women, men and kids, and they carry both lifestyle shoes which are suitable for everyday wear, to technical performance running footwear, for active living. If International K Pop Girl Band – Sistars loves Skechers, you would too.

name: Smiggle
description: Smiggle, the world’s hottest stationery brand! The product range is now bigger and better than ever. Their ultimate goal is to inspire and develop the creative spirits of their customers, by delivering original, fun and affordable stationery. Smiggle products are all about great design and innovation, bold colour, quirky graphics, great value and most of all – giving fans the tools they need to have fun! Come visit their friendly team at VivoCity today!

name: Solace Studios
description: Established in 2022, Solace Studios is Singapore’s leading Korean-Style Self Photo Booth Studio. Featuring 6 physical outlets and several pop-up booths across Singapore, Solace Studios is the top-of-mind choice for those seeking a memorable photobooth experience. Solace Studios is continuously exploring ways to offer unique experiences, by crafting creative concepts based on the hottest trends. MISSION: Accessibility and Affordability. We believe that everyone should have the opportunity to capture moments during outings, special occasions, or spontaneous times. Which is why Solace Studios is accessible at multiple locations across the island at affordable rates.

name: Sole Lovers
description: A little fun is good for your Soles…Their founder, Mr Edison Lee, who has been in shoe business for past 29 years, said “Life is too short to waste away wearing ill fitting and unflattering mumsy shoes”. Indeed…at Solelovers they curate together some of the most exciting shoes from the world over. From Brazilians Sambas of Colors, Spanish Dash and Italian Craftsmanship, Solelovers pledge to bring you the best. “There’s a certain unmistakable “hmmm’ whenever one fits into a stylish and comfortable shoes… such joys are not easily replicable”.So come and find your joy in Solelovers !

name: Song Fa Bak Kut Teh 松發肉骨茶 (Since 1969)
description: Established in 1969, Song Fa Bak Kut Teh has grown to become a time-honoured and prominent name in the local food scene. High-quality pork ribs are carefully simmered with garlic and pepper to create the signature clear and peppery soup, often enjoyed with braised dishes and Kung Fu tea. At Song Fa, one can relive the heritage of good old Bak Kut Teh in its truest sense.

name: Spectacle Hut
description: Express service in 30 minutes. Spruce up your look with quality eyewear from Spectacle Hut. Find YSL, Dita, Dior Homme, Tom Ford, Oliver People, Bottega Veneta, Gucci, Prada and cult brands like Chromehearts, Bathing Ape plus limited edition pieces! Contact lenses available too. In addition, Spectacle Hut has been awarded the Influential Brands Award as the No. 1 Top Brand under the Optical Retailer Category for 2017 & 2016.

name: SPLATTIFY
description: Splattify is an experiential art studio built around two signature zones: the Paint Factory and Slime Lab. Together, they create an immersive, hands-on environment where guests explore colour, texture, and creativity in a fun and accessible way. Designed as an energetic, sensory-rich space, Splattify encourages active participation and self-expression rather than passive entertainment. Each experience is crafted to be engaging, memorable, and highly shareable, driving longer dwell times, repeat visits, and strong organic social media amplification.

name: Standard Chartered Bank
description: Standard Chartered in Singapore is part of an international banking group with more than 84,000 employees and a 150-year history in some of the world’s most dynamic markets. Standard Chartered has a history of 157 years in Singapore, opening its first branch here in 1859 and in October 1999 was among the first international banks to receive a Qualifying Full Bank (QFB) license, an endorsement of the Group’s long-standing commitment to its businesses in the country.

name: Starbucks Coffee
description: Since 1971, Starbucks Coffee Company has been committed to ethically sourcing and roasting the highest quality arabica coffee in the world. Today, with stores around the globe, the company is the premier roaster and retailer of specialty coffee in the world. Through their unwavering commitment to excellence and guiding principles, they bring the unique Starbucks Experience to life for every customer through every cup.

name: Stellar
description: Stellar specialises in silver jewellery and ear piercing services that caters to diverse skin types and age groups. To date, we have customised ear piercing services for more than 10,000 children and adults, making us one of the leading brands that is trusted for our quality service. Using high-grade and advanced piercing technology made in U.S.A, Stellar Piercing Technicians are equipped with the skills and experience to ensure your piercing is a smooth and pleasant process. Pierce with Stellar, Pierce with Confidence.

name: Steve Madden
description: Steve Madden started with a $1100 investment in 1990 and has become a leading footwear brand. Inspired by rock and roll and his New York roots, Madden’s unique designs have revolutionized the shoe industry, providing an outlet for individual expression. He has expanded the brand to include handbags and accessories and now sells over 80 countries worldwide. Madden’s innate understanding of trends and willpower has attracted millions of customers and made the Steve Madden brand a truly lifestyle destination. It’s about embracing authenticity and individuality. It’s Steve Madden.

name: Strip
description: The first international concept waxing boutique since 2002, Strip has thriving outlets all over the world. Keeping things smooth in Singapore, London, New York, Shanghai, Hong Kong, Kuala Lumpur, Jakarta, Manila, Bangkok, Strip has pruned and waxed a staggering three million bushes (and counting). Strip offers quality services and advanced techniques when it comes to pre- and post-wax care. Their range of specially concocted hard wax and products ensures that your Strip experience is as painless as it gets!

name: stryv
description: The Stryv Squad is an eclectic mix of individuals who want beautiful, fuss-free hair routines without the hefty price tag. After speaking with hundreds of women, we realised that we could be the perfect balance between technology and affordability. No one has time to visit the salon every day, so we decided to take the salon experience home.

name: Stuff'd
description: Stuff’d offer quality, tasty freshly prepared meals, yet affordable. Readily available islandwide for consumers to personalize their orders anytime, anywhere. Celebrating every wrap and bowl we prepare, as we bring joy to everyone.

name: Sun Paradise
description: Sun Paradise carries a range of swimming equipment and gear, which includes U.V. wetsuits that provide warmth and comfort to children, contemporary bikinis and sophisticated swimwear. The brand also possesses a variety of goggles, kick boards, swim cap, snorkeling accessories for both adults and children that are designed for appeal, while maintaining top level functionality. Sun Paradise believes in delivering comfort for you to enjoy under the sun. Gearing up for a causal day at the pool or beach, training for a upcoming swimming competition, playing any water sports. Sun Paradise will bring you what you need.

name: sunnystep
description: Sunnystep is a modern footwear brand known for its Asian fit, ultra comfort, stable support and a versatile style. With acupressure massage insoles and skin-friendly materials. Sunnystep shoes allow you to walk or stand for the whole day with no pain. It was started after the founder suffered from a traumatic postpartum spine injury and needed the most comfortable and supportive shoes. It’s a local Singaporean brand with a mission to help everyone move freely and happily. It believes that health starts from the feet and the right shoes are critical for the optimal body alignment and good health.

name: Surrey Hills Grocer
description: The name “Surrey Hills” is an ode to two eponymous townships that reside in Australia. Inspired by the scenic autumn forest landscapes at the quaint Surrey Hills town in Melbourne, and finest baked goods at Surrey Hills, an inner-city suburb of Sydney and hip strip known for its vibrant cultural and café scene, Surrey Hills Grocer was borne of a desire to bring that same tranquil, comfort and delight to Singapore.

name: Sushi Tei
description: Sushi Tei – Where pristine culinary skills and incisive expertise with an innate appreciation of nature come together to inspire and enhance the experience of true Japanese dining. Their menu features Japanese offerings and innovative dishes illustrating the emerging influence of Asia on modern Japanese cuisine, appealing to the delight of aficionados of Japanese cuisine. With the modest and unassuming homegrown Japanese Kaiten (conveyor belt) chain, it is by no revelation that Sushi Tei conform to an open-kitchen concept that allows patrons the prerogative to relish the mouth-watering savories amidst the gazing of the culinary skills of the restaurants’ chefs.

name: Swarovski
description: Delivering a wonderlab of meticulously crafted jewellery & accessories, Swarovski brings artistry & elegance into the everyday lifestyle. Celebrate individuality & break the rules of style where innovation meets imagination.

name: Swatch
description: Discover the latest Swatch collections and explore the world of Swatch. Founded in 1983 in Biel, Switzerland. Swatch revolutionized the Swiss watch industry with its spirited design, pioneering technology and momentous success from the first Swatch Originals to the Skin and an amazing variety of Swatch Irony watches. Swatch continues to offer a multitude of innovative & unique timepieces with models like SISTEM 51 Irony, Swatch X You and SKIN Irony!

name: Swensen’s Unlimited
description: Indulge in a taste of nostalgia at Swensen’s Unlimited, an international buffet experience nestled in Singapore’s bustling VivoCity. Featuring iconic Swensen’s delights and a kaleidoscope of 48 rotating ice cream flavors, this inviting outlet is perfect for families and friends to gather and enjoy hearty meals together. Savor a diverse array of cuisine, ranging from hot dishes and live stations to fresh seafood, all in a warm and welcoming atmosphere, creating cherished moments with loved ones.

name: Tai Cheong Bakery
description: Established in 1954, Tai Cheong Bakery was started by egg tart Master Au Yeung’s uncle, who later handed down the business to Au Yeung. He then pioneered the cookie crust for egg tarts using skills picked up while working in western style kitchens. Tai Cheong gained popularity with locals and foreigners alike, reaching its peak when Chris Patten (then governor of Hong Kong) started frequenting the original outlet at Lyndhurst Street. In 2016, Tai Cheong opened its first outlet in Singapore, quickly gaining popularity with its freshly baked items and signature egg tarts. Today, Tai Cheong continues to serve customers from all walks of life with an ever increasing range of innovative and traditional products.

name: TALAD THAI BANANA ตลาดไทย
description: Talad Thai Banana is an authentic Thai recipe crafted with love. Their unique batter is made from fresh hand-picked ingredients prepared daily with love and good intentions. All products are vegan-friendly and made in fresh batches daily!

name: 谭木匠 Tan Mujiang
description: Tan Mujiang preserves Chinese craftsmanship, specializing in handmade wooden products like combs and mirrors. Merging ethnic heritage with contemporary design, all pieces use premium materials and hold 60+ patents. With 200+ domestic outlets and global presence, Tan Mujiang strives to lead the wooden lifestyle market, rooted in its core values: “Honesty, Hardwork, Happiness.”

name: TANGS
description: An icon of Singapore, TANGS is a leading player in the retail industry that has its fingers constantly on the pulse of the ever-changing consumer wants and trends. Singapore’s most distinctive and beloved department store raises the bar in retail, stepping up its role as a curator of a spectrum of exciting Asian as well as international brands, and redefining the shopping experience with refreshing store concepts.

name: TANGS
description: An icon of Singapore, TANGS is a leading player in the retail industry that has its fingers constantly on the pulse of the ever-changing consumer wants and trends. Singapore’s most distinctive and beloved department store raises the bar in retail, stepping up its role as a curator of a spectrum of exciting Asian as well as international brands, and redefining the shopping experience with refreshing store concepts.

name: TANYU 探鱼
description: TANYU specialises in grilled fish in over 70 major cities in China with more than 300 outlets. Well known for its signature flavor Grilled Fish with Fresh Green Pepper, TANYU first stepped foot in Singapore in 2017 and now has 7 outlets across the island. Catering to the diverse tastes of local Singaporeans, TANYU makes use of a variety of cooking methods and offers 8 kinds of flavors for its grilled fish, such as tingling & spicy, savoury, garlicky and more!

name: TCC - The Connoisseur Concerto
description: tcc – The Connoisseur Concerto is the leading chain of art boutique cafes boasting a comprehensive selection of gourmet food and creative beverages. Unveiled on 18th December 2003, tcc has been the leading purveyor of gourmet coffees in Singapore, marked by their extensive range of exclusive top-quality coffees, brewed to perfection using a variety of brewing methods. Since then, their food menu has expanded to include gourmet delights – prepared and artfully arranged to satisfy the senses. At tcc, take a step back from the buzzing city life by reclining on their posh furniture and be enveloped in pure sophistication and satisfaction.

name: Team Salon
description: TEAM SALON is a dynamic and esteemed name in the industry. Seamlessly weaving the best of colour chemistry, sophisticated cutting techniques, as well as the amazing talent and creativity of its hair artists, to give you new and outstanding styles, showing the world a more beautiful and confident you. Its strong customer base of regulars, along with the good press it has garnered over the years will certainly attest to this. Customer service is a top priority at Team Salon, and the team will not hesitate to ensure that the needs and comfort of every customer is earnestly met.

name: Tech House
description: Tech House exclusively offers customers a full range of Anker and Spigen premium products such as mobile phone case, audio, powerbank, charging solution, portable projector, smart house products and more.

name: Tempura-EN
description: Tempura-EN embraces the craft of Japanese tempura. Each piece freshly made upon order and delicately fried to bring out the natural flavours of each ingredient. Upholding the commitment to quality, craftsmanship, and elegance in every dish by using premium ingredients and authentic Japanese flour, dashi, and sauces. Alongside its signature tempura, Tempura-EN also offers kaisendon with taidashi, fresh sashimi, and carpaccio selections — a harmonious showcase of comforting Japanese flavours.

name: teva
description: Teva’s original sport sandal was created on the shores of the Grand Canyon back in 1984. Looking for a way to prevent sandals from floating downstream, a resourceful river guide strapped two Velcro watchbands to a pair of old flip flops, and just like that, Teva was born.

name: The Body Shop
description: The Body Shop is a global manufacturer and retailer of naturally inspired, ethically produced beauty and cosmetics products. Founded in the UK in 1976 by Dame Anita Roddick, they now have over 2,400 stores in more than 60 countries, with a range of over 1,200 products.

name: The Coffee Bean & Tea Leaf
description: Born and brewed in Southern California since 1963, The Coffee Bean & Tea Leaf® is the oldest and largest specialty coffee and tea retailer in the United States. Embodying a passion for connecting loyal customers to one another with carefully handcrafted products, the company is known for sourcing and providing the finest ingredients and flavors from around the world. For 50 years, The Coffee Bean & Tea Leaf® has demonstrated a passion for product innovation epitomized by The Original Ice Blended® beverage.

name: The French American Bakery
description: Devoted to crafting excellence, we prioritise using the finest, high-quality ingredients to ensure every bake is a masterpiece infused with passion. Our mission is to bring the best quality treats to our community, offering competitively exquisite bakes because we believe that everyone deserves to experience the joy of savouring exceptional baked goods right in their own neighbourhood.

name: The Hour Glass
description: Established in 1979, The Hour Glass is one of Asia’s leading specialty watch retailers representing international watch marques such as Rolex, Girard-Perregaux and Hublot. Known for our passion for designing uniquely immersive retail experiences and our team of highly knowledgeable watch specialists, we strive to become the primary port of call for all watch enthusiasts and collectors alike.

name: THE NORTH FACE
description: Founded in 1966 in San Francisco, California, The North Face is the world’s premier outdoor brand embodying a spirit that is authentic, innovative as well as technical. The brand carries an extensive range of best-in-class outdoor and performance apparel, equipment, accessories and footwear that will inspire and enable people to never stop exploring. The North Face at VivoCity Mall is a first of its kind in Singapore, featuring the brand’s highly coveted utilitarian technical urban lifestyle collection; the Urban Exploration.

name: The Original Beach Road Scissors Cut Curry Rice Since 1930
description: Founded in 1930 by Mr Lee Ah Hock, Beach Road Scissors Cut Curry Rice started its humble beginnings as a food cart parked at Clyde Terrace Market “铁巴刹” before making its way to the now iconic 229 Jalan Besar shophouse. As an immigrant from Hainan, China, Mr Lee dedicated his work to serving labourers with a modest meal of rice, curry and chap chye (mixed vegetables) at affordable prices. Since then, Beach Road Scissors Cut Curry Rice has been passed on for 4 generations and is a household name that has won numerous awards. The brand currently enjoys an international celebrity following, who swear by its authentic 2-sauce recipe.

name: The Paper Bunny
description: Founded in 2013, The Paper Bunny is a lifestyle brand that combines function and aesthetic to create thoughtful pieces for intentional everyday living and thoughtful gifting. Known for their thoughtfully designed pieces, including highly sought-after bags and accessories, the brand is committed to creative explorations, impactful experiences and delivering well-designed products through meaningful campaigns and engaging retail spaces.

name: The Pet Safari
description: It’s going to get awfully fun! Step into The Pet Safari and it’ll be like stepping into a theme park! The Pet Safari has everything your pet needs under one roof; grooming services, pet care consultants, training classes, pet cafes and bakeries, and over 14,000 products to choose from!

name: The Shirt Bar
description: The Shirt Bar sets out to make an impact in the fashion industry. Going against the tide, The Shirt Bar is the antithesis of fast fashion. Slow fashion as they call it, stitches together value, ethics and sustainability. Working with like-minded partners that share similar values, The Shirt Bar commit themselves to excellent craftsmanship and innovative designs, crafting products of superior quality, comfort and fit, designed to last through wear and trends. The Shirt Bar believes that everyone can initiate their own ripples of change, one small action at a time. With each conscious purchase, customers can join them on this shared mission. They hope to inspire individuals on a shared journey of impact, to Make That Impact, For All That Matters, in whichever areas of life you choose to do so. #MakeThatImpact

name: THEFACESHOP
description: THEFACESHOP is a leading global beauty retail brand offering over 1,000 quality products for skin care, body care, hair care and make up. As a one-stop beauty store, THEFACESHOP carries a variety of brands housed under the parent company of LG Household & Health Care, from skincare, to makeup, to body care.

name: TheJellyHearts
description: WHERE THE SWEETEST DREAM BEGAN There was once a fairy with a sweet tooth who loved to bake for her friends and family at home. Her desserts and treats were a big hit, drawing visitors from all over fairyland and beyond to her kitchen in droves. Nothing could stop them from coming, not even the fact that her house was on a cloud. As orders started piling up and words traveled further away, the fairy made the decision to move down to a tiny island and open a shop selling her signature jelly cheesecakes. The delighted islanders regarded these cakes as a scrumptious treat and work of art, with the power to bring happiness and brighten people’s day. Soon, one shop became ten shops all over the island, creating a small kingdom called TheJellyHearts. As they continue to make magical desserts, they hope to inspire everyone to make the most of every moment and embark on extraordinary experiences.

name: Tim Hortons
description: At Tim Hortons®, you are always welcome. Founded in Canada in 1964, Tim Hortons is proud to be Canada’s favourite coffee house, serving a broad range of crowd favourites like signature lattes, world-famous Iced Capps, donuts, Timbits and fresh baked goods.

name: Timezone
description: Immerse in the latest interactive games and rides at Timezone VivoCity, Timezone’s first ever flagship store in Singapore! Play their carnival games and win paper tickets to redeem prizes at the new prize shop! Spin, bump and dodge on LED-lit bumper cars; and keep the bowling ball out of the gutters of Highway66 Mini Bowling, which features shorter lanes, automated bumpers and lighter balls. There’s fun for everyone at Timezone!

name: Tiong Bahru Bakery
description: Be it a quick coffee break before heading off to your next shopping destination or just enjoying a delicious meal with your loved ones, Tiong Bahru Bakery offers a wide variety of viennoiseries, breads, pastries and beverages that will leave you spoilt for choice. Each freshly baked good is created using time-honoured techniques, with the best ingredients which have been lovingly sourced and curated from France.

name: Toast Box
description: Established in October 2005, Toast Box is Singapore’s iconic contemporary-styled coffee chain recreated to preserve the culture of Nanyang Coffee and Toast served in coffeeshops during the 60s and 70s. Step into Toast Box and the fragrance of freshly-ground caramelized coffee beans, complemented by a menu of familiar home favourites, infuses a vibrancy of life into every store, bringing people together to share in the never-forgotten taste of a bygone era.More than merely preserving this endearing culture, Toast Box is now also brewing in China, Hong Kong, Indonesia, Malaysia and Taiwan, to share the delightful experience beyond our shores.

name: Tokyo Shokudo
description: Award-winning Gold Medalist Chef Akimitsu Tanihara’s self-developed No-Pork-No-Lard Ramen and Tendon is the first of its kind in Singapore. Bringing along his years of experience as the 5th generation successor, his self-created masterpiece, (Godaime Tendon), loosely translated as 5th Generation Tendon won the gold medal at the Japan Donburi Awards for 6 years in a row. Tokyo Shokudo also offers a variety of Ramen, Rice Sets and Donburi, all of which are crowd-pleasers and family-friendly dining options.

name: Tommy Hilfiger
description: With a brand portfolio that includes Tommy Hilfiger and Hilfiger Denim, Tommy Hilfiger is one of the world’s most recognized premium designer lifestyle groups. They focus on designing and marketing high-quality men’s tailored clothing and sportswear, women’s collection apparel and sportswear, kidswear, denim collections, underwear, footwear and accessories.

name: Tonkatsu ENbiton
description: Tonkatsu ENbiton, a destination for authentic tonkatsu experiences. We pride ourselves on sourcing the finest pork from renowned farms in Japan and around the world, ensuring the highest standards of quality and flavour in every dish. Our commitment to excellence ensures that every cut of pork we serve maintains the highest standards of quality and flavour.

name: Toys“R”Us
description: Toys”R”Us is positioned as “the Worldwide authority on kids, families and fun”. It is the largest child-related product specialty chain store in the world. Toys”R”Us believes in providing a happy shopping experience to customers with the biggest selection of toys and baby products priced to offer best value for money.

name: Tsuzumi Dango つづみ団子
description: Freshly crafted in Nagasaki, Tsuzumi offers wagashi that blend taste, care, and tradition.

name: Typo
description: Welcome to Typo. We design stationery, travel and gifting that’s anything but ordinary, helping you bring a little more creativity into your everyday. Wherever you’re heading and whatever’s brewing — a trip, a gift, a moment, or a mess of ideas — we’ve got you. It’s all about turning the everyday into something that feels a bit more like you.

name: Una Una
description: Una Una takes pride for its flavorful and nutritious eels. Revel in delight as you watch our Unagi chefs cook up your favorite unagi cuisines over charcoal grill. Slathered with our in-house sweet & savory tare and grilled over hot charcoal, the unagi at Una Una boasts a crispy exterior and soft and tender interior boosting a fragrant smoky aroma. Savor Unagi in different styles, or pair them with your favorite sake at Una Una.

name: unbottled
description: We’re on a mission to build the swankiest lifestyle hangs. Why you ask? Because you’re are here on a first date, meeting our emotional support companions. We are but merely the sherpas in your journey, completing your unbottled transition. We look forward to welcoming you.

name: Under Armour
description: Ready to take your game to the next level? At Under Armour, our mission is to create state-of-the-art products engineered to make athletes perform better. Over the years, Under Armour has evolved from an apparel manufacturer to an innovative, research-driven company that enhances human performance. Packed with useful design features to keep you free from distraction, we pride ourselves on helping athletes beat their PB and take their game to the next level! Our Under Armour store in VivoCity offers a wide range of shoes, accessories, sports, and casual apparels. Come in and meet our friendly and knowledgeable staff who are ready to assist you with any questions or queries you might have.

name: UNIQLO
description: Apparel that comes from the Japanese values of simplicity, quality and longevity. Designed to be of the time and for the time, LifeWear is made with such modern elegance that it becomes the building blocks of each individual’s style. A perfect shirt that is always being made more perfect. The simplest design hiding the most thoughtful and modern details. The best in fit and fabric made to be affordable and accessible to all. LifeWear is clothing that is constantly being innovated, bringing more warmth, more lightness, better design, and better comfort to people’s lives.

name: Unity
description: Established in 1992, Unity Pharmacy’s mission is to moderate the cost of healthcare in Singapore through quality products and services at affordable prices. With over 60 outlets across the island, it also aims to improve the health and total well-being of its customers with trained pharmacists who provide professional advice to support the needs of the community. Unity Pharmacy is part of the social enterprise NTUC FairPrice, a multi-format retailer which seeks to moderate the cost of living in Singapore.

name: UOB
description: UOB is a leading bank in Asia with a global network of more than 470 branches and offices in 19 markets in Asia Pacific, Europe, and North America.

name: VALENTINO
description: Valentino Beauty reveals beauty as an open playground where new dreams come to life. An invitation to an individual expression of diversity and personality through the three codes of color, cool, and couture.

name: Veggie House 一芳素食
description: Veggie House is a casual vegetarian dining brand in Singapore, with six outlets serving up familiar local favourites in a fully plant-based way. Inspired by local favourites, we offer a wide variety of dishes such as vegetarian bento sets, laska, chicken rice, nasi lemak, nasi briyani ,noodles and more- all thoughtfully crafted without meat, but never compromising on taste. Our dishes are inspired by the tastes Singapore love, offering a satisfying and enjoyable experience whether you’re vegetarian or just looking for a lighter meal. We believe vegetarian food should be simple, affordable and accessible, with hearty portions, quick service and consistent quality. With convenient locations, Veggie House is your go‑to spot for tasty, satisfying vegetarian meals anytime.

name: Venchi
description: Founded in 1878 in Turin, Italy, Venchi brings over a century of chocolate-making heritage to your table. Indulge in authentic Italian chocolates and gelato, crafted from the finest ingredients. Enjoy a wide selection of plant-based and gluten-free options of premium pralines, iconic Chocoviar, artisanal spreads, and freshly churned gelato for a true taste of Italian tradition and sweetness.

name: Venus Beauty
description: Venus Beauty was born in 2002 with the simple concept of retailing quality everyday products at affordable prices. From personal care, fragrance, household, and even baby products, you are bound to find something that you need!

name: Vicoletto Osteria
