description: Vicoletto Osteria crafts every artisanal pizza with precision and passion, delivering flavors that set us apart. From timeless Margheritas to our unique specialty offerings, each slice showcases the essence of Italian cuisine. Complement your pizza with charcoal grills, house-made pasta, delicious antipasti and decadent desserts for a full Italian feast that captures the true spirit of Italy.

name: Victoria's Secret and Pink by Victoria's Secret
description: VICTORIA’S SECRET: Victoria’s Secret is the world’s largest specialty intimates retailer offering a wide assortment of modern, fashion-inspired collections including signature bras, panties, lingerie, casual sleepwear and athleisure, as well as award-winning prestige fragrances and body care. With nearly 1,400 retail stores worldwide and a predominately female workforce of more than 25,000, Victoria’s Secret boasts the largest team of specialty trained bra fit experts worldwide. Victoria’s Secret is committed to inspiring women around the world with products and experiences that uplift and champion them and their journey while creating lifelong relationships and advocating for positive change. VICTORIA’S SECRET BEAUTY: Victoria’s Secret Beauty is America’s #1 fragrance brand.* With an iconic portfolio led by the award-winning fragrances Bombshell, Tease and Heavenly, Victoria’s Secret Beauty proudly touts six of the top 25 fragrances in the U.S. From Eau de Parfum to scented body care and more, Victoria’s Secret fragrances add luxury to every woman’s daily life. Complementing the fragrance assortment is the Victoria’s Secret Accessories Collection, featuring the latest styles in handbags, cosmetic cases, cold weather accessories and more. Victoria’s Secret serves customers at more than 1,400 Lingerie and Beauty stores around the globe, making it the largest direct-to-consumer fine fragrance brand in the market *Source: Euromonitor, US retail unit sales, 2018, includes perfume, Eau de Parfum, Eau de Toilette and colognes, aggregated sales of all Victoria’s Secret fragrance brands. PINK: WHO WE ARE PINK is a lifestyle brand focused on celebrating and supporting the power of community, fostering positive mental health among young adults, and being kinder to the planet. Together with our customers, PINK honours diversity, equity and inclusion, self-confidence, and individuality. Our products are made to feel good both inside and out and include loungewear, knit tops, bras, panties, activewear, accessories, beauty, and more.

name: VietSmith
description: Enjoy re-imagined Vietnamese cuisine at VietSmith. Experience a fresh, contemporary take that transports you to Saigon. Savor signature beef phở, simmered for hours in a rich beef broth, and classic street food like shrimp spring rolls and crispy Vietnamese pancakes. Delight in modern twists on stir-fried dishes like Tiger Prawn Lemon Basil Fried Rice and sharing favorites such as Grilled Saigon Chicken with cơm tấm, and Flame Grilled Catfish with Homemade Sauce. Join us for a mouth-watering dining experience with a curated menu blending modern and traditional fare.

name: VIVAIA
description: VIVAIA is a global footwear brand founded in 2020, dedicated to supporting everyday life with eco-friendly comfort and style. Today, the brand offers a wide range of comfortable, on-trend footwear DTC across more than 61 countries and regions worldwide, and collaborates with leading global partners to craft its shoes using recycled and eco-friendly materials. VIVAIA是一家全球鞋履品牌於2020年創立，致力於以環保舒適和時尚支持日常生活。目前，品牌提供多元化的舒適時尚鞋履，以DTC模式銷售至全球超過61個國家和地區，並與全球頂尖合作夥伴共同以回收及環保材料打造每一雙鞋履。

name: W OPTICS
description: At W OPTICS, they believe in offering tailored vision care services and providing optical solutions and products that cater to the specific needs of customers. The W EYExperience offers eye examination that is tailored to your individual needs, from standard to a comprehensive eye check to screen/diagnose different eye conditions or eye diseases.

name: Waa Cow!
description: Enjoy Singapore’s best flame-torched Wagyu beef rice bowls and more Japanese-inspired creations in their first family-centric flagship outlet. Delight your palate with a selection of innovative & premium Donburis together with delectable small sharing plates, kids meals and affordable happy hour offerings.

name: Watches of Switzerland
description: Watches of Switzerland is a prestige watch retailer that was established in Singapore since 1964. As part of The Hour Glass Group, Watches of Switzerland caters to consumers in both principally located shopping districts and the burgeoning affluent sub-urban towns in Singapore, with a total of three boutiques located island-wide. Watches of Switzerland features brands such as Omega, TAG Heuer, Longines, Breitling and Tissot.

name: Watsons
description: Singapore’s Leading Health & Beauty Retailer Watsons is Asia’s No. 1 Personal Care and Beauty Offline + Online Retailer, with close to 100 stores islandwide and the flagship health and beauty brand of the A.S. Watson Group. It continually sets the standard in heath, wellness, and beauty by providing personalized and related advice and counselling to customers and a market-leading product range in their offering, so that they can ‘LOOK GOOD, DO GOOD, FEEL GREAT’ every day. Other accolades and awards received include Omnichannel Strategy of the Year 2023 – Singapore and Health & Beauty Retailer of the Year – Singapore consecutively from 2021 – 2023 by Retail Asia Awards and ‘Best HR Digital Transformation Strategy’ at the prestigious Employee Experience Awards 2023. Watsons accepts NETS, DBS PAYLAH!, VISA, MASTERCARD, AMERICAN EXPRESS, JCB, DINERS CLUB INTERNATIONAL, UNIONPAY.

name: WESTON CORP
description: Weston is Singapore’s Premier Soccer Store with the largest collection of Soccer Boots & Jerseys.

name: WHITE 三巴旺白米粉
description: White Restaurant, a household name known for its Original Sembawang White Beehoon, served the world its first taste of a new Singapore classic since 1999. Each clang of the ladle, each toss and stir, the high fire that smokes every bite with “wok hei” flavour. The cooking style that appears hasty is in truth perfected by decades of experience. A dish made out of rice vermicelli soaked in a rich and thick broth, which comes with seafood, egg, and vegetables. The way it has always been. The way it will always be. Original.

name: WILSON
description: Wilson is a sports brand that brings more than a century of innovation, history, and heritage across multiple sports, including tennis, baseball, padel, football, basketball, volleyball, pickleball, and golf. Our equipment, game balls and apparel are thoughtfully designed and developed to empower athletes at every level around the world to perform at their best. Through player insights, we are able to innovate at new heights and develop cutting-edge equipment and apparel. Wilson, as an Amer Sports brand, helps elevate the world through sport.

name: Wine Connection
description: Wine Connection is the leading chain of wine shops and wine-themed restaurants in South-East Asia. Established in 1998, Wine Connection has been developing expertise in wine for over 18 years.

name: WJL 永裕隆
description: When you integrate self-care intentionally into your daily routine, you naturally thrive from within. That is the essence of local wellness brand WJL, curating a diverse range of selections ranging from wild-harvested ginseng and everyday herbs to convenient health foods and lifestyle wellness products. With a strong history rooted in premium oriental herbs since 1947, WJL is committed to providing high-quality wellness products to support you through every season of life, nurtured by nature’s goodness.

name: WOK HEY
description: A modern, fast-casual, convenient take-out concept. WOK HEY offers tasty, nutritious, value-for-money, customisable fry-to-order rice and noodle wok dishes.

name: XIANG XIANG HUNAN CUISINE 湘香湖南菜 (SINCE 2009)
description: We are a locally established chain of Hunan cuisine in Singapore, with more than 15 outlets across the island since 2009. Authentic and rare Hunan cuisine concepts to the Singaporean dining scene, offering a culinary experience that is both unique and deeply rooted in tradition. We take pride in being pioneers in this niche, setting ourselves apart from competitors by bringing the rich and diverse flavours of Hunan to a locals.

name: Xin Yuan Ji Fish Soup Singapore 新源记
description: Xin Yuan Ji Fish Soup Singapore 新源记 is a popular 31-year-old fish soup restaurant, cherished for its comforting bowls of fish soup. Serving one of Singapore’s favorite cuisines, it has built a loyal following with its fresh ingredients and rich, flavorful broth.

name: Xpressflower.com
description: At Xpressflower.com, they offer more than just flowers! The name Xpressflower.com was chosen to mean the flower as an expression of love. Their continuously efficient service emphasises their focus on the Internet as an integral part of the company’s long-term expansion plan. That is part of their vision to be recognised as the leading flowers & gifts service providers in the region. They are here for their customers 24/7, committed to offering only the freshest flowers and gifts, backed by delivery service that is reliable and prompt.

name: Ya Kun Kaya Toast
description: Serving a humble fare of coffee, tea, egg and toast, Ya Kun Kaya Toast exemplifies how less is more. Generously slathered with our special kaya recipe that stood the test of time, Ya Kun is undoubtedly the choice coffee shop to get your breakfast fix. Expanding the menu to include other local delights as well, start the your day right with Ya Kun Kaya Toast.

name: Yakiniku Like
description: Tasty! Quick! Value! Originated from Japan, Yakiniku Like is a solo-dining barbeque concept restaurant that allows customers to enjoy top-quality meats at a value price! The restaurant serves premium meats like Wagyu Beef to your usual staple food such as Pork and Chicken.

name: Yamazaki
description: Yamazaki Baking Company was founded in Japan in 1948 and is renowned for providing reasonably priced, fresh, high-quality baked products in wide variety such as sweet buns, fresh cakes, Japanese confectioneries and European style hard breads. Since then, Yamazaki Baking Company has modernized through aggressive technological advances and the installation of state-of-the-art equipment. The company then expanded to other major cities in Asia in 1981, where the Japanese-styled breads were very well accepted.

name: YANG MING SEAFOOD (KELONG)
description: Yang Ming Seafood is a popular seafood restaurant with branches in Ubi and Bishan, both known for our fresh live seafood and creative zi char dishes.

name: 幺社宠物 YAOSHE HUB
description: 🐾 Yaoshe Hub – Where Bonds Are Made At Yaoshe Hub, we curate the finest experience in feline companionship. Specializing exclusively in pedigree cats, our philosophy centers on quality, care and ethical breeding. name: Yappari Steak
description: Yappari Steak from Okinawa, Japan – we are one of the biggest steak chains in Japan with over 100 stores in Japan, Nepal, Australia, and Singapore. At Yappari, we served all our 100% Certified Black Angus beef Blue, lightly seared on the outside yet red on the inside on top of our signature lava stone that is heated up to 230-degree Celsius. Our customer can slice and cook their steak further to the doneness of their liking. No more overcooked or undercooked steak!

name: Yeti
description: From coolers and drinkware to backpacks and bags, YETI® products have met the unique and varied needs of diverse outdoor pursuits worldwide, whether in the remote wilderness, at the beach, or wherever life takes our customers.

description: Yew Kee Duck Rice uses the traditional Teochew method of braised duck cooking together with special recipes in braised sauce and chili making handed down by the founder’s father. name: Yong Kang TCM Clinic
description: Yong Kang TCM Clinic is committed to offering a comprehensive range of high-quality TCM healthcare services for maintaining good health and preventing illnesses altogether. We focus on treatments for your common day ailments such as sports injuries, rheumatism, arthritis, men & women health, infertility, migraine, and all types of chronic pain. name: Z T P Ginseng Birdnest
description: Z T P is one of the largest health food retail chains in Singapore. They are also one of the largest bottled Bird’s Nest manufacturers in Singapore. Their range of products include bird’s nest, Australian abalone, Japanese scallops, Mushroom, Ginseng, Cordyceps and many more.

name: Zara
description: Zara opened its first store in the coastal town of A Coruña in the northwest of Spain in 1975. Zara has over 1,900 stores strategically located in leading cities across 87 countries. Zara’s designers and customers are inextricably linked. Specialist teams receive constant feedback on the decisions its customers are making at every Zara store. This feedback inspires Zara’s creative team, which is made up of over 200 professionals. Zara is always striving to meet the needs of its customers at the same time as helping to inform their ideas, trends and tastes. The idea is to share responsible passion for fashion across a broad spectrum of people, cultures and ages.

name: ZooMoov
description: Experience the ultimate family entertainment with ZOOMOOV Safari! Immerse yourselves in an electrifying safari-themed adventure with our exciting electronic rides. From parents to kids, everyone is sure to have a wild time!
